Talents.name: I got my back
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you’ve needed to brave the backstreets for some time without the help of an office, corporation, or syndicate backing you. You gain a Feat of your choice that you meet the prerequisites for from the Fixer Feat page. You gain this feature again at 6th, 10th, 13th, and 17th levels.

Talents.name: Party Tricks
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you have picked up some skills in your time as a fixer. Choose either 2 skills to gain proficiency in or one skill to gain expertise in. You also gain a +1 to a stat of your choice.

Talents.name: Workshop Expertise
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your workshop weapons become stronger and cheaper. Workshop weapons cost half as much for you, and may hold +1 augment slots on your workshop weapons.

Talents.name: Workshop Regular
Talents.desc: At 10th level, while other groups have hardsuits that speed up your reactions, serums that regenerate limbs from nothing, or even the ability to manipulate blood. All the while you have a dull knife and a denim jacket, so naturally workshops help even the playing field. You gain the ability to equip an additional workshop item that does not count towards your total. This item must follow all other guidelines for workshop weapons as listed on the Workshop Weapon Creation page.

Talents.name: Varied Proficiency
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you may gain proficiency in a saving throw of your choosing.

Talents.name: Apex Fixer
Talents.desc: At 17th level, gain a +2 to a stat of your choice, raising the maximum for that stat by 2. Then, gain a +1 to all stats.

Talents.name: Face the Fear, Build the Future
Talents.desc: At 1st level you gain the ability to utilize equipment called EGO gear sooner than most could ever dream of from the Fixer Tools page. You can bypass all requirements to acquire these items except for the level requirements. Additionally, you are given a pistol that does 1d6 piercing damage, holds a magazine of 12 bullets, and has a range of (30/90). You gain 1 at 1st level, and then additional ones at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th levels.

Talents.name: Cognition Filters
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you have been given a pair of contact lenses that automatically censor forces or imagery that may be harmful to your mental state. You gain advantage on all saving throws that may alter your mind in any way, this includes status conditions such as frightened, charmed, or any effect that affects the brain.

Talents.name: Team Leader
Talents.desc:
At 6th level you are promoted to team leader (mainly because the last one died). With this you are given an armband. Choose which department you are the team leader of. This decision cannot be changed later.

* Control Team: You may grant yourself advantage on one check once per long rest.
* Information Team: Gain advantage on all investigation and history checks and gain proficiency in those skills too. If you previously had.
* Training Team: Gain an ability score improvement (this cannot be used for a feat)
* Security Team: +1 hp every level
* Central Command Team: +10 movement speed
* Welfare Team: You can make a medicine check on an ally who is downed with a DC=10. On success, they recover 1d10+medicine modifier hit points and are no longer downed. You may use this once per long rest.
* Disciplinary Team: +1 to all attack rolls
* Extraction Team: Gain a +1 to all damage rolls
* Record Team: The DC of all features you have is increased by +1

Talents.name: Specialized Bullets
Talents.desc:
At 10th level you gain access to special bullets that you can fire out of the pistol you were given upon your hiring. These special bullets can be shot at yourself, hostiles, or allies to gain their benefits. As an action you may fire off one of these bullets. You do not need to make an attack roll if you are within 5ft of your target. You may use any of them at a given time but may only use them a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

* Green: Recover 4d10 hit points or regenerate a limb fully in an instant. If you recover a limb this way, gain a level of exhaustion.
* Blue: Gain advantage on all mental saves (Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma) for the next 3 rounds
* Red: Gain immunity to slashing, piercing, and bludgeoning damage for the next 3 rounds
* White: Gain immunity against psychic, radiant, and necrotic damage for the next 3 rounds
* Black: Gain immunity to fire, cold, thunder, and lightning damage for the next 3 rounds
* Pale: Gain immunity to effects that would kill you outright (Ex: power word kill) for the next three rounds.
* Slow: You may target a hostile creature within your weapon's range and make an attack roll against them. On hit deal weapon damage and cause the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On failed save the target is slowed as seen in the Slow spell. You do not need to maintain concentration on this, and target may make a Wisdom save at the end of each of its turns to recover from the slow condition.
* Execution: If you hit a creature with remaining HP less than or equal to your current level + Proficiency bonus, they are killed outright.

You may only benefit from one bullet at a time.

Talents.name: Again, and again, and again…
Talents.desc: At 13th level, your world has repeated an unknown amount of times from that god forsaken facility, only no gaining clarity. You gain advantage on death saving throws. Additionally, when being reduced to 0 hit points, you may return to 1hp once per long rest.

Talents.name: Overcoming Adversity
Talents.desc:
“There was this… thing… that woke up in the facility today. I handled it to the best of my ability but, I’ve been changed. I’ll never look at the world the same.”

At 17th level, the facility you work in had successfully suppressed an incredibly strong abnormality, so powerful in fact that in its death it gave everyone a gift.This gift adds something to the body that physically changes them such as a cluster of eyes on the cheek, a pair of black wings with glowing yellow eyes, or even a little pink heart on your chest, the appearance of this “gift” is up to you. Gain a +2 to all stats and their maximums, a +2 to attack and damage rolls, and a +2 to AC.

Talents.name: Gone Angels
Talents.desc: At 1st level, your experience in the Library of Ruina has gifted you with the experience to make it on your own and have a knack for looking out for yourself. You cannot be surprised while conscious and you can detect where traps are within 15ft of you. Additionally, your short rests are only 30 minutes, and your long rests are only 4 hours.

Talents.name: Ripping Pages
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, remnants of your abilities from within the library have stayed with you. Everyone is a book filled with knowledge and experience that is worth reading. When you kill a hostile creature, you may take any 1 of its features, proficiencies, racial traits, etc. You must be the one that kills the creature to use this benefit. You can utilize a number of pages at once equal to your proficiency bonus but may hold a number of features (pages) equal to your level. Upon gaining a page above your maximum, you may replace one that you already know, losing the replaced page entirely.

Talents.name: Struggling Through the Dark
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you know how to patch yourself up quickly and move onto the next fight. After leaving combat you may expend a number of hit dice up to your proficiency bonus and regain that many hit points.

Talents.name: That's that and this is this
Talents.desc: At 10th level you’ve adopted a mindset where not much gets to you, and even if it does, you can brush it off pretty quickly. You gain advantage on any saving throws that may affect your mind. Additionally, if you are affected by a condition that affects you mentally, on your turn you may use an action to automatically succeed the saving throw to remove it.

Talents.name: Power Struggle
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you've experienced enough combat to say that you are becoming a force of nature, something to compare to the characters in fairy tales. Your attacks count as magical for the sake of overcoming resistances and treating immunity to magical attacks as if it were resistance.

Talents.name: Head Librarian
Talents.desc: At 17th level you have been entrusted with a floor of the library, in which you gain incredible benefits. Once per long rest you may use an action to use three pages you have consecutively. This can be three attacks, three utility moves, allow you to make wisdom saves, ect. This feature however removes the ability to use those pages used in this feature for the next 1d4+1 turns. If in the event these features had cooldowns or recharge rolls innately, their cooldowns or rolls may only begin after those 1d4+1 rounds are concluded.

Talents.name: Four Trigrams
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you have become a member of the esteemed Hana Association. Your organization is in charge of grading and overseeing all transactions between the associations and corporations and as such they require a level of professionalism. You gain access to the Four Trigrams, allowing you to choose one at the beginning of each of your turns and retain its benefits until the start of your next turn. When using a Trigram, you may grant its benefits to all allies within 10ft of you.

* Geon: Gain a +2 to attack and damage rolls.
* Gon: When taking the Dodge or guard action, you gain a +2 benefit to your AC and Saving Throws.
* Gam: Choose a feature that states they have a finite number of uses per short or long rest, it gains 1 more usage while this Trigram is active.
* Ri: Gain an additional bonus action for the turn. This bonus action can only be used for the dash, disengage, and hide actions.

You may use your Trigram Feature a number of times equal to double your proficiency bonus.

Talents.name: Forward March
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your preparations have made you ready to react at the blink of an eye. When a creature enters or leaves your melee attack range, you may make a single melee weapon attack against them.

Talents.name: Divinatory Impact
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your quick reflexes and judgment allow for you to quickly swap from offensive to defensive at the blink of an eye. When taking the attack action, you may exchange one of your attacks for either the dodge or block action, only being able to dodge or block one incoming attack (ex: the opponent is making two attacks. You may only use the defensive option for the first attack).

Talents.name: Hana For All
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, your association has prided itself on helping the public and holding other organizations to its standard. When using a Trigram, you may grant its benefits to all allies within 20ft of you. Additionally, the benefits of your trigrams have improved.

* Geon: Gain a +4 to attack and damage rolls.
* Gon: When taking the Dodge or guard action, you gain a +3 benefit to your AC and Saving Throws.
* Gam: Choose 2 features that states they have a finite number of uses per short or long rest, it gains 1 more usage while this Trigram is active.
* Ri: Gain an additional bonus action for the turn. This bonus action can now be used as a normal bonus action rather than its previous limitations.

Talents.name: Unyielding Strike
Talents.desc: At 13th level, your methods are concrete and you apologize no nobody. Once per long rest you may make an attack roll against a target. On hit deal 2x weapon damage and impose a Strength saving throw. On failure the target is stunned until the end of your next turn.

Talents.name: True Trigram Formation
Talents.desc: At 17th level, your expertise has shown through and the shape of the true trigram is revealed to you. On the start of your turn you may temporarily double the benefits of all trigrams and enable all of them at once. You gain an additional action for this turn and double all available movement speed. At the end of your turn after activation you are unable to use any trigrams for the duration and your movement speed is halved until the end of the following turn. This feature cannot be affected by the Gam Trigram.

Talents.name: Law and Order
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you’ve joined the Zwei association, an Association that, in every sense of the word, maintains law and order and protect the citizens of the city. As such you training reflects that.

You gain the `Protection::Protection` `fighting style::Fighting Style` from the fighting style list, and the `Protector::Protector` feat. Along with that you have been given a Martial or Simple Melee weapon with the Heavy property.

Talents.name: Retaliate
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your protectiveness can only help somebody so long as the aggressor stands down or lies down. When using your reaction to protect an ally using protection or protector, you may make a single attack against them as part of the reaction. This attack counts as an opportunity attack for the sake of any other features. At 10th level, upon hitting a creature with the opportunity attack provided from this feature, inflict 1 `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down` onto the target creature.

Talents.name: Protect and Serve
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your mere presence puts others at ease. You gain an aura of protection to all allies within 10ft of you. All allies in range gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1) and a bonus of +1 AC. Additionally any hostile creature that is within the range will have their Damage Rolls reduced by your proficiency bonus if they are targeting a creature other than yourself.

Talents.name: Focused Defense
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your constant defense of others allows for a more resilient self. You gain +2 AC, and you may now use the protector feat for 1 light. Additionally, after protecting an ally, they have advantage on all attack rolls against the hostile target until the end of their next turn.

Talents.name: Flexible Suppression
Talents.desc: At 13th level, the best defense is a good offense. For every attack you land during your turn, gain 1 `Protection::Protection` this turn and at the start of your next turn, up to a maximum of 3 Times per turn.

Talents.name: Guardian
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you’re at the pinnacle of your class and a top-notch defender. At 17th level, Increase the range of Protect and Serve by 5 ft. When gaining `Protection::Protection` through Flexible Suppression, another Ally with the lowest HP will gain the Protection as well. Additionally, increase your Fixer DC, Saving Throw Rolls, and `Clash::Clashing` Rolls by +1 for every Protection on self, up to a maximum of +10.

Talents.name: Your Shield
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you’ve joined the Zwei association, an Association that, in every sense of the word, maintains law and order and protect the citizens of the city. As such you training reflects that.

You gain the `Protection::Protection` `fighting style::Fighting Style` from the fighting style list, and the `Protector::Protector` feat. Along with that you have been given a Martial or Simple Melee weapon with the Heavy property. This weapon is considered a workshop weapon for any future upgrades or augments. It does gain the below benefit without using an augment point.

Shell-Shock Nullification - Whenever you make a melee attack with this weapon you gain and inflict 2 `Tremor::Tremor`. At the beginning of your turn, for every 3 Tremor on you, you may gain 2 Protection to a maximum of 3 protection per turn. Alternatively for every 6 Tremor you may gain 1 `Defense Level Up::Defense Level Up` next turn to a maximum of 3 per turn.

Talents.name: Zwei Knight's Form
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, you have sworn an oath to use these three styles of combat in service of protecting yourself and those around you from harm, should it come your way as you have pledged yourself to the slogan of the Zwei - Your Shield - and you're damn sure you'll live up to the standard

When using your reaction to protect an ally using the `Protection::Protection` `fighting style::Fighting Style` or `Protector::Protector` Feat, you may make a single attack against them as part of the reaction after which you may apply one of the following forms.

**Zwei Knight's Form - Quaking Suppression**

You retaliate back with a powerful strike that usually suppresses most aggressor.

Gain 1 Defensive Stance. The next melee attack you inflicts (`Tremor::Tremor` on self x 2, Max 10 Tremor) Tremor onto the target creature.

**Zwei Knight's Form - Guard**

You retaliate by standing your ground and assuming a defensive stance in front of an ally, ready to shoulder their burden head on.

Gain 2 Defensive Stance, 10 Tremor, and your next attack triggers `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` onto the target creature.

**Zwei Knight's Form - Staredown**

You retaliate back not with your sword, but with your charm, charisma and most importantly, your piercing gaze

You gain 3 Defensive Stance and 2 Tremor. The targeted creature must then make a Charisma Saving Throw against your fixer DC. On a failure, trigger Tremor Burst on the creature, and the creature gains the Frightened Condition against you until the end of your next turn. if the creature passes the saving throw you gain these effects instead.

**Defensive Stance: Max Stack: 3**

This effect is reduced by 1 at the end of your turn. Your Initiative drops to a 1 until this effect expires. You gain 8 plus your proficiency bonus, then divided by 2 `Aggro::Aggro` until this effect expires each turn. When you win a clash you trigger Tremor Burst onto the target creature.

Talents.name: Assistance and Order
Talents.desc:
At 6th level, Your steadfast presence bolsters allies while your own body stands tall as an obelisk of help to those in need

You emit an aura with a radius of 10 feet. Allies within the aura gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of +1). Additionally you gain +2 AC, and you may now use the protector feat for 1 light. After protecting an ally, they have advantage on all attack rolls against the hostile target until the end of their next turn

Talents.name: Formation Breaker
Talents.desc:
You're time and loyalty to the Zwei have taught you how to exploit instability at the perfect moment, of those who try to hurt your clients.

At 10th level, when a creature within 30 feet gains `Tremor::Tremor` from you or one of your allies, and its Tremor reaches 6 or higher, you may use your bonus action to immediately trigger a `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst`.

When you do:

* The Burst deals additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
* One ally of your choice within 30 feet gains `Protection::Protection` equal to your Constitution modifier.
* The target has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

You may use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Talents.name: Ward of The Guardian
Talents.desc:
You have figured out, that in all of your time spent under oath of the Zwei and following their slogan, that offense is the best defense

At 13th Level, at the start of every round, and whenever using either the `Protection::Protection` `Fighting Style::Fighting Style` or `Protector::Protector` Feat, you may give yourself and one other ally of your choice that is within 30 feet 1 `Defense Level Up::Defense Level Up`.

When using your reaction to protect an ally using the Protection fighting style or Protector Feat, you may make an another attack against them in addition to the original attack as part of the reaction after which has the following properties

At Turn Start, if your have Defensive Stance, gain 1 Defense Level Up and 2 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`.

Upon hitting a melee weapon attack, inflict and gain 4 `Tremor::Tremor`. You may also consume up to 20 Tremor on self and inflict 1 Tremor for every 2 Tremor Consumed, if 10+ Tremor was consumed, you may trigger `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` onto the target creature. Trigger Tremor Burst an additional time if your have Defensive Stance when activating this effect.

Talents.name: Immovable Wall
Talents.desc:
You’re at the pinnacle of your class and a top-notch defender, people know you Wing wide and praise you for your work

At 17th Level, for every attack you land during your turn, gain a +1 to AC until the start of your next turn, to a maximum of +3, additionally your aura now grants the same bonuses to AC. Along with that your Aura range is increased to 15ft together with. Finally, any AC benefits you gain from this feature grant a benefit to your attack and damage rolls on your next turn (Example: if your AC benefit from the last turn was +3, all attack and damage rolls this turn have a +3).

Talents.name: Gathering Intel
Talents.desc: At 1st level you are taught about what is expected of you as part of the Seven Association. Intel is the name of the game, and by god you better be able to deliver. You gain proficiency in Investigation checks. If you are already proficient you may gain expertise. Additionally, you may use your intelligence for your perception checks, and gain proficiency in Perception checks. If you are already proficient you may gain expertise. You gain the `Seven Section’s Blade::Seven Section's Blade` as part of signing up to the Seven Association.

Talents.name: Analyzing Weakness
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, you are taught that everything has a weakness, nothing is invincible. On your turn after landing an attack against a hostile creature, you may use your bonus action to analyse an opponent by making an investigation check contesting their intelligence score. On success you learn if they have any damage vulnerabilities. When attacking a creature’s vulnerability, you may roll an additional dice when determining damage. In addition, when making an attack, you may choose to aim for a target area. Doing this gives you a -8 to your attack roll, but can give an extra effect depending on the area. A creature may make a constitution saving throw to resist these effects. You may do this an amount of times per long rest equal to your intelligence modifier + your proficiency bonus:

* Eye: The creature is blinded for two turns
* Ear: The creature is deafened for a minute
* Mouth: The creature cannot speak for a minute
* Nose: The creature cannot smell for a minute.
* Neck: Your critical hit range for this attack is 12-20, but your critical miss range is 1-9.
* Arm: The creature cannot use this arm for two turns.
* Leg: The creature cannot use this leg for two turns. A creature with a lost leg has a halved movement speed and cannot dash.

Talents.name: Exploit the Gap
Talents.desc: At 6th level you have been on enough missions to not only analyse a weakness, but to exploit it to the fullest. Your critical hit range is increased by 2 when attacking a creature with an attack that deals a damage type they are vulnerable to. Additionally, you have advantage on your investigation checks to find their vulnerabilities.

Talents.name: Policy Analysis
Talents.desc: At 10th level you have done enough paperwork to supply three lifetimes, you fully understand how to look for the fine details not just in paperwork, but in life. You have advantage and a +20 on all checks to determine if something is out of place such as but not limited to your food being undercooked, a law having a loophole, your coffee being poisoned, why does my bag of holding keep losing my items? You know, normal stuff.

Talents.name: Split the Armour
Talents.desc: At 10th level, as an action, you may make an attack. If this attack hits, the opponent is inflicted with 3 `Defence Level Down::Defense Level Down` and you gain 3 `Poise::Poise`. You may do this an amount of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain expended charges on a long rest.

Talents.name: Riposte
Talents.desc: At 13th level, a simple block and parry can go a long way. When you make a clash, if you choose counter, you may roll your damage roll twice and pick the higher option. Additionally, you gain another reaction that may only be used for a clash counter.

Talents.name: Make a Weakness
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you’ve found that you may not always be able to take advantage of a weakness you find, so you may as well make one. Twice per long rest when attacking a target with a damage type they are either normal or resistant, but not immune to, you may choose to lower by a single tier (Normal becomes vulnerable and Resistant becomes normal). The amount of uses of this feature increases to thrice per long rest at 20th level.

Talents.name: Hand to Hand Combat
Talents.desc: At 1st level you are taught how to more effectively use your body to subdue an aggressor. You gain proficiency in unarmed strikes dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage + strength or dexterity. 1d8 at 7th level, and finally 1d10 at 15th level. Additionally, as a bonus action you may make an additional unarmed strike.

Talents.name: Burning Red
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you are taught how to ignite your hands when fighting hand to hand. Your unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d4 fire damage. They deal 1d6 extra fire damage at 6th level, 1d8 at 10th, 1d10 at 13th and 1d12 at 17th. After dealing this additional fire damage, the affected creature will gain this fire damage in `Burn::Burn` stacks.

Talents.name: Force of a Wildfire
Talents.desc: At 6th level your fire burns brighter, leaving the opponent burning. When attacking a creature without `Burn::Burn`, inflict +5 Burn on hit. When you hit a burning creature, deal +3 fire damage.

Talents.name: Intense Blaze
Talents.desc: At 10th level your fire burns brighter, hotter, and longer. `Burn::Burn` stacks you inflict are instead Inferno stacks. Inferno is Burn for all intents and purposes, but are reduced by 1/5th when they deal damage, rather than reduced by 1/3rd. Additionally, when attacking a creature who is under the burn or inferno condition, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls. When attacking an already burning creature, or when a creature with inferno gains burn, they gain Inferno stacks regardless. It is similar to `Tremor::Tremor`, where the original status is converted if the creature had or gains Inferno.

Talents.name: Furious Fire
Talents.desc: At 13th level, your flames build, and build, and build, before erupting in a cataclysmic inferno. If you critically hit a creature that is currently under the inferno condition, you may remove all their inferno stacks, making them take 1d4 fire damage per inferno stack they had. This cannot be increased by `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`, but Offense Level Up adds a fifth of the inferno stacks to the total fire damage for each Offense Level. This applies in the same way for `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down`.

Talents.name: Perfected Dragon Fist
Talents.desc: At 17th level, your persistent studies and technique improvements have landed you amongst the strongest amongst the Liu. When taking the attack action, you may attack an additional time so long as the opponent is burning or under the inferno condition. When reducing a creature with the burning or inferno conditions to 0 hit points, you gain a +3 to all attack rolls and saving throws for your next turn.

Talents.name: Inner Ardor
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you may raise your allies' morale. As a bonus action, you can inspire an ally within sight of you. That ally will gain a +1 to attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and their DC. At 8th level, this ability improves to a +2. At 15th level, this ability improves to a +3. This benefit lasts until the end of combat, additionally, an ally can only benefit from this once per combat.

Talents.name: Flow of the Sword
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your sword can ignite in flames. Attacks that deal slashing damage deal an additional 1d4 fire damage. They deal 1d6 extra fire damage at 6th level, 1d8 at 10th, 1d10 at 13th and 1d12 at 17th. After dealing this additional fire damage, the affected creature will gain `burn::Burn` stacks equal to this fire damage dealt.

Talents.name: Force of a Wildfire
Talents.desc: At 6th level your fire burns brighter, leaving the opponent burning. When attacking a creature without `Burn::Burn`, inflict +5 Burn on hit. When you hit a burning creature, deal +3 fire damage.

Talents.name: Fervor
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your emotions can heighten your performance in battle. If during a battle a creature that is considered an ally to you is knocked unconscious or killed, you will gain a +2 to attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, ability checks and AC. This bonus stacks up to a maximum of +6 and will persist until the encounter is over, at which point they dissipate. (DM Discretion is advised for this ability). Additionally, when below half hit points, gain 2 `Haste::Haste` and 2 `Protection::Protection`.

Talents.name: Iron Wall
Talents.desc: At 13th level, your defense has now become impenetrable. If the creature attacking you has `Burn::Burn` stacks, then you gain a bonus in AC and `Clash::Clashing` Rolls equal to the creatures Burn stacks divided by 5 (Min 1, Max 10)

Talents.name: Forming Storm
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you can control the flames to create destruction where you swing. Once per turn, when making an attack, each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a dexterity saving throw against your Fixer DC or else they will take 8d10 fire damage, and be inflicted with `Burn::Burn` stacks equal to the damage dealt.

Talents.name: Academic Weapon
Talents.desc: At 1st level, with training and many extended study sessions, you truly see the meaning of Mind of Matter. You may use your intelligence modifier to determine attack and damage rolls. Additionally, you gain proficiency in unarmed strikes dealing 1d6 per strike. This damage increases to 1d8 at 5th level, 1d10 at 10th level, and finally 1d12 at 15th level.

Talents.name: Insightful
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your knowledge of combat has granted you a profound new understanding of effects that may not be as simple as hit or miss. Once per turn when landing an attack roll, make an intelligence check DC=10. On success gain 1 insight to a max up to your proficiency bonus. For every stack of insight, you gain +1 to saving throws.

Talents.name: Methodical Assault
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your insight into the progression of a fight takes your combat to a different level. As a bonus action, you may spend an insight stack to make an additional unarmed strike. This unarmed strike does not grant you insight if it hits.

Talents.name: Study hard, fight harder
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your study on historical combat has hardened your body, giving you a boost to your durability. When landing attack rolls with stacks of insight, you gain your insight stacks worth of temporary hit points.

Talents.name: Scorching Knowledge
Talents.desc: At 13th level, the more books you read, the stranger they seem to be, and with that comes new understanding, and thus, new power. When landing an attack roll, for one insight you may substitute the damage for a grapple check, using your Intelligence in place of your Strength. On success the rest of your attack rolls this turn automatically land but can no longer land criticals. At the end of your turn the target is left prone on the ground. You may use this a number of times equal to your intelligence modifier.

Talents.name: Scholar
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you are top of your class and with that comes a newfound physical strength. As a bonus action, you may expend any number of insight stacks to make that many unarmed strikes. You may not use this feature again until a long rest.

Talents.name: Peering Through a Key
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you gain the ability to manifest a large key to use as a weapon to use in battle. This key will deal 2d4 bludgeoning damage and uses your Wisdom Modifier for attack Rolls and damage rolls. The key you create can be de-materialized as a free action, but it takes an action to create the key during combat. The weapon is considered as Finesse.

Talents.name: Insightful
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your knowledge of combat has granted you a profound new understanding of effects that may not be as simple as hit or miss. Once per turn when landing an attack roll, make an wisdom check DC=10. On success gain 1 insight to a max up to your proficiency bonus. For every stack of insight, you gain +1 to saving throws.

Talents.name: Cyclical Knowledge
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your combat knowledge has improved incredibly. When your insight stack is 3 Or more, then you will gain a +1 to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws. If your insight stack is 5 or more, then these bonuses become a +2.

Talents.name: Expand Knowledge
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your knowledge will upgrade your body. For every stack of insight you have, the damage dice tier of the Dieci Key will go up by one tier (2d4 -> 2d6 -> 2d8) to a maximum of 2d10. At 18th level, the maximum is increased to 2d12.

Talents.name: Unveil
Talents.desc: At 13th level, your attacks will now inflict the `Sinking::Sinking` Status. Each attack that is hit will inflict 3 Sinking onto the targeted creature. For every 5 sinking the creature has, they will lose a -1 to attack rolls and saving throws, and they will lose half of the sinking on round end.

Talents.name: Enlightenment
Talents.desc:
At 17th level, your mind knows all. When targeting a creature, you can spend your insight to make a special attack on the creature. For each insight the special attack will gain the following.

* 1 Insight: Make an attack with the key that has a critical range of 19-20
* 2 Insight: Make two attacks with the key that have a critical range of 18-20
* 3 Insight: Make three attacks with the key that have a bonus +3 to the attack rolls.
* 4 Insight: Make four attacks with the key that have a bonus of +3 to the damage rolls.
* 5 Insight: Make four attacks with the key that have advantage.
* 6 Insight: Make five attacks with the key that have a critical range of 15-20.

Talents.name: Dueling Specialists
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you are taught just how to fight in somebody else’s stead and how to carry yourself as a Cinq associate. You gain the Dueling Fighting style. When winning a clash or hitting a creature with a weapon that's benefiting from the Dueling `Fighting Style::Fighting Style` you gain 1 `Poise::Poise` and gain 1 `Haste::Haste`.

Talents.name: Compelled Duel
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, While landing an attack with a weapon that is benefiting from the Dueling `Fighting Style::Fighting Style`, inflict 1 Compelled Duel. Upon hitting a creature who does not have Compelled Duel, remove all Compelled Duel this unit has inflicted from all other creatures. When hitting a creature who has Compelled Duel, gain the following benefits based on the Compelled Duel Stack.

At 2+ Stack, Gain a +1 to the attack roll

At 4+ Stack, Gain a +2 to the damage rolls when `Clashing::Clashing`

At 6+ Stack, Once per round, your next Clash does expend `Light::Light`. You do not regain light from a successful Clash - Counter follow-up attack.

These effects stack with each other.

When you win a clash, gain a bonus to your damage rolls equal to your proficiency Bonus until the end of your next turn.

Talents.name: Remise
Talents.desc: At 6th level, at the beginning of your turn, you can gain 1 `Haste::Haste` for every 3 `Poise::Poise` on Self, to a maximum of (Proficiency Bonus) Haste gained per turn. When attacking a creature, For every 20 feet of speed that you are faster than the target, gain a +1 to Attack Rolls and `Clash::Clashing` Rolls, to a maximum of your proficiency Bonus - 1.

Talents.name: Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee
Talents.desc: At 10th level, As a bonus action at the cost of six `poise::Poise` you can give two of your allies 2 stacks of `Haste::Haste`. You can also use this feature when you critically strike without expending Poise. These stacks of Haste last until the end of the affected allies turns. When you bestow Haste upon an ally you cannot bestow additional stacks of Haste on that ally until the start of your next turn. Your Poise generation from **Dueling Specialists** increases by 1.

Talents.name: Fleché
Talents.desc: At 13th level, when landing a critical strike with a weapon, you may inflict `Bind::Bind` equal to half your proficiency Bonus, Rounded Down.

Talents.name: Duelist for the Ages
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you have dueled so many people that your renown seems to force people to concede as you show up. But for those who stay and dare challenge you, you’ve got a grand finale waiting for them. When you land an attack or engage in a clash you may choose to either automatically critically strike or automatically win your `Clash::Clashing`, you may do either of these things a combined total of 6 times per short rest. You gain an additional reaction.

Talents.name: Nerve Strike
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, You gain proficiency in unarmed strikes dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage + strength or dexterity. This damage dice increases to 1d8 at 5th level, 1d10 at 10th level, and finally 1d12 at 15th level. Additionally, as a bonus action you may make an additional unarmed strike. On Hit with an unarmed strike, the target will gain 1 Nerve Strike. Upon hitting a creature who does not have Nerve Strike, remove all Nerve Strike this unit has inflicted from all other creatures. When hitting a creature who has Nerve Strike, gain the following benefits based on the Nerve Strike Stack.

At 3+ Stack, Gain a +1 to the damage roll

At 6+ Stack, Gain a +1 to the attack roll

At 9 Stack, Once per Turn, gain 1 `Offensive Level Up::Offense Level Up` next turn.

These effects stack with each other.

Talents.name: Fa Jin
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, when hitting a creature with your unarmed strike, Gain 1 `Poise::Poise` and Inflict 2 `Burn::Burn`. Inflict 1 Additional Burn for every 3 Nerve Strike on the target.

Additionally, your unarmed strike critical hit range is increased to 19-20.

Talents.name: Virescent Pyrojade
Talents.desc: At 6th level, at the beginning of your turn, you can gain 1 `Haste::Haste` for every 3 `Poise::Poise` on Self, to a maximum of (Proficiency Bonus) Haste gained per turn. When attacking a creature, For every 20 feet of speed that you are faster than the target, gain a +1 to Attack Rolls and `Clash::Clashing` Rolls, to a maximum of 4.

Talents.name: Virescent Flame Palm
Talents.desc: At 10th level, upon landing a critical hit with an unarmed strike, you will inflict 1 `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down` for every 6 `Burn::Burn` on the target, to a maximum of 2. If the target has Nerve Strike, increase the maximum of the previous line by 2.

Talents.name: Featherstride Technique
Talents.desc: At 13th level, upon landing a critical hit with an unarmed strike, you may use a free action to activate a dodge, while in this dodge, if a creature attacks you and misses, you will gain 1 `Poise::Poise` and 1 `Haste::Haste` at the start of your next turn. If the attacking creature has Nerve Strike, it will lose an amount to their attack roll equal to (Nerve Strike On Target / 3, Rounded Up).

Talents.name: Virescent Flames
Talents.desc: At 17th level, your unarmed strikes gain 1d4 fire damage. This fire damage scales in the following ways. Upgrade the Dice Tier for every 10 `Burn::Burn` on the target and for every 5 `Poise::Poise` on self. The fire damage dice inflicts Burn equal to half of the fire damage dealt, and the damage dice cannot be upgraded by other features.

Talents.name: Verify Obligation Fulfillment
Talents.desc: At 1st level, whenever you hit a creature with a melee attack using a polearm, it gains +5 `Tremor::Tremor` stacks. On critical hit, trigger `Amplitude Conversion::Amplitude Conversion` into `Tremor - Decay::Tremor - Decay` or inflict `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst`.

Talents.name: Execution Advised
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, against creatures with 20 or more `Tremor::Tremor` stacks, your melee attacks deal an additional 1d6 damage. Whenever a creature suffers a `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` from you, it immediately gains +5 Tremor stacks after the burst.

Talents.name: Final Warning
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your critical hits, or any hit against a creature with 20 or more `Tremor::Tremor` stacks, apply +5 additional Tremor stacks.

Talents.name: Do Not Obstruct
Talents.desc: At 10th level, as a reaction after getting attacked by someone else then the last creature you attacked, choose up to 3 creatures that can see and hear you. Each must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature is Frightened until the end of your next turn and gains +5 `Tremor::Tremor` stacks. On a success, the creature gains +3 Tremor stacks. You can use this feature once per combat.

Talents.name: Grave Attendance
Talents.desc: At 13th level, whenever a creature within 30 feet suffers a `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst`, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Allies within 10 feet of you gain a +2 bonus to AC so long as you are conscious.

Talents.name: Execution Sentencing
Talents.desc:
At 17th level, whenever a creature reaches 60 or more `Tremor::Tremor` stacks, or suffers a `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` at 80 Tremor, you gain a single usage of Execution Sentencing. As an action, you may expend your usage to force a creature within melee range to make a Constitution saving throw. On failure if they are at 100 hit points or below, they are killed outright. On success at above 100 hit points or on failure at below 100 hit points, target takes 10d10 non negatable weapon damage. On success above 100 hitpoints, target takes half damage.

After using Execution Sentencing successful or not, all enemies within 30 feet who can see or hear you gain +10 Tremor stacks.

Talents.name: Swordplay of the Homeland
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you begin your training in the Swordplay of the Homeland. Your attacks now critically hit on a roll of 19-20. While using a sword, you may choose to deal piercing damage instead of slashing damage. For the purposes of `Blade Master::Blade Master` and similar feats, you still count as using a purely slashing weapon for their benefits. Every attack that you land, you gain 2 `Poise::Poise`. This Poise gain increases by 1 at level 3, level 6, level 10, level 13 and level 17.

Talents.name: Overthrow
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you become adept at punishing an opponent even when they overpower or outmanoeuvre you. As a reaction to being hit by an attack, you may make an attack of opportunity against the attacker. If this attack was made as a result of a failed `Clash::Clashing` - Counter or Clash - Stall, gain 5 `Poise::Poise` before making that attack. You gain an additional reaction for only this feature.

Talents.name: Decisive Strike
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your poise persists even after hitting your mark, and your focus allows you to take advantage of openings, even when they come at your own harm. When you critically hit, after expending `Poise::Poise`, gain 3 Poise. Additionally, while at 5 or more Poise, you gain an additional reaction that may only be used for Overthrow.

Talents.name: Yield My Flesh
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your own health means nothing if you can use it to your advantage in a fight. When clashing with a `Clash::Clashing` - Counter, you may choose to set all of your rolls to 1 for that clash, and reduce your AC by 10 against that creature for its counterattack, along with making that counterattack automatically critically hit. If you fail the clash, and if the creature hits you and deals damage, you may use Overthrow, making an additional attack and gaining 5 `Poise::Poise` before each of them, to a total of 10 Poise before each attack including Overthrow.

Talents.name: Unrelenting
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you have become nearly impossible to put down for good. You take halved damage from `Bleed::Bleed`, `Burn::Burn`, `Poison::Poison`, `Tremor::Tremor`, `Rupture::Rupture` and `Sinking::Sinking`, the Paralyze debuff does not apply to your attack rolls or damage rolls, apart from clash rolls. When you would drop to 0 hit points, you return to 1 hit point and cannot go below 1 hit point until the end of your next turn. This benefit may only be used once per long rest.

Talents.name: To Claim Their Bones
Talents.desc: At 17th level, when triggering Yield my Flesh, you may force the creature to roll maximum damage on their attack. If you do so, you do not make reaction attacks against them. On your turn, you may make a special attack action, making 2 additional attacks for each trigger of Yield my Flesh in the past round. Your movement speed triples for this turn, you gain advantage on all of your attacks and you do not roll for damage, instead always dealing maximum damage. The final attack forces creatures within 60ft to make a dexterity saving throw, taking damage equal to the critical damage of the weapon on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. This saving throw has its DC increased by 10, and the damage on the last part counts `Poise::Poise` damage for all of the creatures damaged, rather than being expended after dealing damage to a single one, and can trigger `Rupture::Rupture`. Killing a creature with this ability gives you another attack, up to 2 more total. After using this ability, roll 1d6 at the start of your turn. On a roll of a 6, you may use this ability again.

Talents.name: Augmentation Tattoos
Talents.desc: At 1st level, by joining the Kurokumo Clan, you were given a set of augmentation tattoos. You gain +10 speed to all available movements and may disengage as a bonus action.

Talents.name: Deep Cuts
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, with precise swings, you can make the opponent bleed. For every attack you land, the opponent gains 3 stacks of bleed. When you crit on an attacks, inflict 2 extra bleed.

Talents.name: Precision
Talents.desc: At 6th level, while wielding a katana, your critical range increases to 19-20. Additionally, your critical range increases again when attacking a bleeding target to 18-20.

Talents.name: Artful Ecstasy
Talents.desc: At 10th level, the blood they bleed is the paint your brush needs to create the beauty of death, and to do that, you need more. When inflicting bleed on an already bleeding target, you increase the amount of bleed inflicted by +1. This bonus increases to +2 at 17th level.

Talents.name: Superiority
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you feel a sense of superiority over those who are bleeding and they know that. While a target is bleeding, once per turn you may impose a -1d4 to an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check they make as a reaction. You must impose this feature before the roll is made. Regardless of if their roll fails or succeeds, you regain that reaction at the end of that creature's turn.

Talents.name: Sky Clearing Cut
Talents.desc: At 17th level, your painting needs one last stroke to be perfect. As an action, you may make an attack against a creature within your range. On hit deal 5x weapon damage. If the attack is a critical and the target is bleeding, inflict `bleed::Bleed` stacks equal to double the count. You may use this feature once before making a recharge roll of a 6 on a 1d6. You may make this recharge roll at the beginning of each of your turns.

Talents.name: Gang of Gamblers
Talents.desc: At 1st level, your attacks with Light Finesse weapons inflict 3 `bleed::Bleed` on hit. When you or a creature within 60ft roll a natural 20 or a natural 1, you gain 1 Wishpower Tattoo. When you make a roll, you may expend 2 Wishpower Tattoo to reroll it. You may also spend 1 Wishpower Tattoo to increase or reduce the rolls of a creature within 60ft of you, including you. For example, if a creature rolled a 19 to hit, and you have 18 AC, you may use 2 Wishpower Tattoo to change their roll to a 17, missing you. You may have a maximum amount of Wishpower Tattoo equal to your proficiency bonus + 1, and they expire after 1 minute of being obtained, although they cannot expire while in combat.

Talents.name: Gambler's Fallacy
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, when you hit an attack with a Light Finesse weapon you may roll a 1d20 , on a roll of 16 or higher, attack again. When making this attack, the roll to make another attack off of it is increased by 2, up to a maximum of a 20 to make another attack. After making 4 extra attacks, you may no longer use Wishpower on that chain of attacks.

Talents.name: Take a Chance
Talents.desc: At 6th level, gambling has surrounded you for enough time that you know how to take a chance. When making an attack with a Light Finesse Weapon you may roll a d12, on a roll of 1-6 reduce that attacks damage by that much, on a roll of 7-12 increase that attacks damage by that much. (this is not affected by `offense level up::Offense Level Up` or `defence level down::Defense Level Down`, but is affected by critical hits e.g a roll of 6 will reduce that attacks damage by 12 , a roll of 12 will increase that attacks damage by 24)

Talents.name: Shank
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your follow-ups are lethal and allow for a more devastating blow. When attacking a creature whose hit points are below 25% with a Light Finesse Weapon, you may make an additional attack as part of your attack action that deals critical damage. Additionally, your critical range increases to 18-20 and light finesse weapon damage dice are equal to 1d10 unless your previous dice roll is higher, in that case increase the dice tier by 1. This increased crit range counts for your Wishpower Tattoo generation.

Talents.name: Glinting Wish
Talents.desc: At 13th level, when you miss an attack with a Light Finesse Weapon, you may reroll the attack with disadvantage. You can only do this once per attack. You gain +1 Wishpower Tattoo when you would gain Wishpower Tattoo.

Talents.name: Mutilate
Talents.desc: At 17th level, gain access to the mutilate action. Mutilate - Make an attack with a Light Finesse Weapon, on a hit the attack deals x3 damage and x3 `bleed::Bleed`, if this attack kills the target you may move up to half your movement and take this action again with no action cost. If this attack hits a creature with 10+ bleed (before applying bleed from this attack) this attack counts as a critical hit.

Talents.name: literally just cheating
Talents.desc: At 21st level, when rolling a die, you can choose the number you roll. This number does not have to be on the die.

Talents.name: Antagonism
Talents.desc: At 1st level, Whenever you deal damage with a melee attack, you gain +1 cumulative bonus damage (max +5) until the end of the combat. If you miss a melee attack, this bonus resets to zero. Upon a critical hit apply `Rupture::Rupture` = Antagonism stack. Additionally, whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to regain 1d6 + your Strength modifier in hit points. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your Strength modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.

Talents.name: Smack Down
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, When you hit with a melee attack, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Fixer DC. On a failure, they are knocked prone and suffer 6 `Rupture::Rupture`. If the target is already prone, they take an additional +2d8 bludgeoning damage. Additionally, when using any feature that can knock an opponent prone, you may bypass immunity treating it as resistance or treating a resistance to the condition as normal. If this is the case, creatures roll the saving throw with advantage rather than being immune or as normal instead of at advantage.

Talents.name: You Must Suffer More
Talents.desc:
At 6th level, while you are below half your hit points you gain the following benefits.

* You have advantage on melee attacks and always apply `Rupture::Rupture`.
* When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against them (once per round).

Talents.name: Upheaval
Talents.desc: At 10th level, you may activate Upheaval as an action. You may only use Upheaval against a prone target. Take an attack action, with all attacks deal an additional 1d8 bludgeoning damage and applies twice as much `Rupture::Rupture`.

Talents.name: Relentless
Talents.desc: At 13th level, your rage knows no bounds and your strength can shake the earth beneath your feet. As an action you may cause all creatures within 15ft of you to make a Dexterity saving throw. On failed save, creatures take damage equal to your weapon's damage roll as force damage and fall prone and have their movement speed reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn. On successful save targets take half damage and do not fall prone. You may use relentless a number of times equal to half of your strength modifier rounded down.

Talents.name: Time to Repent
Talents.desc: At 17th level, You channel the fury of every moment you were stepped on and humiliated into a devastating attack that imposes fear and pain. When you make a melee attack, you can activate Time to Repent. On hit deal weapon damage + 3d10 + 3d10 force damage and apply 12 `rupture::Rupture`. After using this feature, you may make a recharge roll at the end of each of your turns. On a 1d6 roll of 6, you may use Time to Repent again.

Talents.name: Stiletto
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, when this character uses weapons that have the finesse and light property that deal piercing damage gain a +2 to attack rolls and damage rolls.

Additionally, once per turn after landing a melee attack roll you may impose a Constitution saving throw onto the target hit. On failure the creature is inflicted with the Open Wound status.

**Open Wound**

The affected creature gains 1 `bind::Bind` at the start of its next turn. Max Stacks: 2 At the end of this creature’s turn if they have 2 Open wound stacks convert all stacks to Deep Wound.

**Deep Wound**

On `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst`, affected creature gains 2 `Bleed::Bleed` Turn End: Target gains Deep Wound stacks - 1 Bind until the end of its next turn. Turn End: Decrease Deep Wound stacks by 1

Talents.name: Mercé
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, when an ally attacks a target that is below 40% HP and within your movement reach, you may use your reaction to move to that creature and make a single weapon attack onto the creature, this attack has a -4 to attack rolls and on hit will inflict 1 Open Wound onto the target.

At 8th level, this attack has a -2 on attack rolls, and at 15th level it will not have any loss to the modifier of the attack roll. (The modifier is added onto your current weapons attack roll)

Additionally you gain an additional reaction that may only be used for this feature and opportunity attacks. You gain a second one of these reactions at 9th level and a third at 15th.

Talents.name: Seize ya Chance
Talents.desc:
At 6th level, your opportunity attack range is increased by 5ft. You may make opportunity attacks against creatures who move within your melee reach. After hitting a creature with an opportunity attack, you inflict 3 `tremor::Tremor` and 3 `bleed::Bleed` onto the target.

Alternatively, you may forgo the tremor and bleed to instead inflict `tremor burst::Tremor Burst`. When a creature with Deep Wound is affected by tremor burst, remove all Deep Wound stacks and apply 3 Fatal Wound stacks.

**Fatal Wound**

On Tremor Burst, affected creature gains 4 Bleed Turn End: Target gains bind equal to Fatal Wound stacks Turn End: Decrease Fatal Wound stacks by 1

Talents.name: Chink in One's Armor
Talents.desc: At 10th level, enemies that are inflicted with `Bind::Bind` will lose AC equal to the amount of Bind on them, up to a maximum of 3. This maximum is increased to 5 if the creature has the Fatal Wound status effect.

Talents.name: Execution
Talents.desc: At 13th level, after you hit an attack against a target, it may use the Mercé feature against the target creature, this will expend a Mercé for the round. Twice per long rest, you may also activate the Seize ya Chance feature onto the target creature.

Talents.name: The Night's Awl
Talents.desc:
At 17th level, you may make a melee weapon attack that gains a +1 to attack rolls for every 4 (`Bleed::Bleed` + `Tremor::Tremor`) (Max +4) on the target creature. On Hit, if target has Open Wound or Deep Wound, convert the stack into 3 Fatal Wound, After this effect, inflict 10 Tremor and 10 Bleed, and trigger `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` onto the target creature, the targets Tremor is not lowered by this attack.

You may make this action when activating Seize ya Chance. You may use this feature two times before needing to take a long rest.

Talents.name: Sand Splitting Slash
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, your attacks will feel like rough sand slashing through creatures. On Hit with attacks, you may choose to inflict either 3 `Tremor::Tremor` or 3 `Sinking::Sinking` and 1 `Sheut Fracture::Sheut Fracture`. If you hit a creature after winning a clash with the creature, you inflict (Proficiency Bonus, Max 4) Sheut Fracture instead of 1.

**Sheut Fracture**

This effect has a maximum stack of 10. Upon reaching Max Stack, Trigger `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` and `Sinking Deluge::Sinking Deluge` on self, and Gain 3 `Blue Sand::Blue Sand`, then remove all Sheut Fracture.

Talents.name: Hawk's Eye
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, At the start of your turn, you can give the ally who suffered the most damage in the round (Proficiency Bonus - 2, Max 3, Min 1) `Protection::Protection`. You will also gain the amount of Protection that was given to an ally as a part of this feature.

Talents.name: Mirage
Talents.desc: At 6th level, At the start of your turn, if you have taken at least 10 base hit points of damage (not including temporary hit points) during the round, then gain (HP Damage Taken / 5, Max Proficiency Bonus * 5) temporary hit points and give half of the gained temporary hit points to the lowest HP ally. These temporary hit points expire at the start of your next turn.

Talents.name: Vanguard Combatant
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, you will gain access to the Vanguard Shotgun as a new weapon. You will gain proficiency with this weapon. You will also gain 16 LCA Fracture Rounds to use with any Ranged Weapon.

* LCA Fracture Round: When loaded into a ranged weapon, On Hit, Inflict 2 `Sheut Fracture::Sheut Fracture`, and if the target has 20+ `Sinking::Sinking` or `Tremor::Tremor`, trigger `Sinking Deluge::Sinking Deluge` or `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst`.

After completing a long rest, you gain up to 16 LCA Fracture Rounds. Upon completing a short rest, you gain up to 8 LCA Fracture Rounds.

Talents.name: The Scepter of Horus
Talents.desc:
At 13th level, whenever there is a creature that has the effect `Blue Sand::Blue Sand` or `Blue Sandstorm::Blue Sandstorm` participating in combat, this unit will gain the following buffs.

* Gain +15 Feet of Movement Speed
* Gain 1 `Protection::Protection`
* Gain advantage against the creature with Blue Sand or Blue Sandstorm
* The creature with Blue Sand or Blue Sandstorm has disadvantage on attacks against you
* Inflict +1 `Sinking::Sinking`, `Tremor::Tremor`, and `Sheut Fracture::Sheut Fracture`

Talents.name: Blue Sandstorm
Talents.desc: At 17th level, your `Blue Sand::Blue Sand` status effect is empowered into Blue Sandstorm. Whenever `Sheut Fracture::Sheut Fracture` would inflict Blue Sand, Inflict Blue Sandstorm Instead.

Talents.name: Got a screw loose?
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you can apply `Tremor::Tremor` with your strikes. Upon hitting an enemy with a melee attack, you can either inflict an amount of Tremor equal to your weapon damage on yourself or inflict an amount of Tremor equal to half of your weapon damage on your enemy. Upon having more than 20 Tremor on yourself, you can double the tremor application against an enemy. Upon crit, you can trigger `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` on a target.

Talents.name: Redistribution of Wealth
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you have learned how to redistribute even the most vague things. As a bonus action, you can trigger `Amplitude Conversion::Amplitude Conversion` for `Tremor::Tremor` on yourself and turn it into `Tremor - Distribution::Tremor - Distribution`. As a part of the same bonus action, you can give your Tremor - Distribution stacks to your allies. For you, the buff of Tremor - Distribution has an upper limit equal to double your Proficiency Bonus instead of +3. Upon having Tremor - Distribution, your `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` DC is reduced by your Intelligence modifier.

Talents.name: No Offense
Talents.desc: At 6rd level, as a reaction when someone within your movement is stunned from `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` effect, you may do a follow-up melee attack moving up to your movement speed to reach them.

Talents.name: Collective Achievement
Talents.desc: At 10th Level, when an allied creature you can see fails an Ability Check or a Saving Throw, you can help it by using your rich experience, and add your Intelligence Modifier to their roll. You have an amount of usages of this feature equal to double your proficiency bonus and recover all uses of it on a Short or Long Rest.

Talents.name: Ready for a Beating?
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you learned how to use your ingenuity to debilitate your enemies. Upon Critting, you trigger `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` or either `Amplitude Conversion::Amplitude Conversion` or `Amplitude Entanglement::Amplitude Entanglement`. You can converse `Tremor::Tremor` into `Tremor - Reverberation::Tremor - Reverberation`. You also can trigger Amplitude conversion on hit, but to do it you need to consume 20 `Tremor - Distribution::Tremor - Distribution` on yourself.

Talents.name: For the Greater Good
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you can make four weapon attacks as an Action and consume all `Tremor - Distribution::Tremor - Distribution` on yourself to gain +1 to attack and damage rolls per 10 `Tremor - Distribution::Tremor - Distribution` consumed. The first attack you land will inflict `Amplitude Conversion::Amplitude Conversion` or Entanglement into `Tremor - Reverberation::Tremor - Reverberation`, user’s choice. All attacks after will then trigger `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst`. If consumed more than 30 Tremor - Distribution, all Tremor Bursts except the last one don't halve Tremor stacks, upon consuming more than 50 Tremor - Distribution on yourself, make an additional attack. If less than 30 Tremor - Distribution is consumed, return all stacks back to the user and trigger Tremor Burst on user before all attack rolls.

Talents.name: Vengeance Tattoos
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you have joined the middle. Upon doing so they gave you tattoos that glow purple and strengthen you. You gain proficiency with unarmed strikes. When using unarmed strikes or weapons with lesser weapon damage die you can choose to deal damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength or Dexterity Modifier instead of the usual damage. This damage increases to 1d8 at 5th level, 1d10 at 11th level and 1d12 at 17th level. Additionally, your AC now equals 10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your Constitution modifier. To gain the benefits of your below abilities, your damage die on your weapon must be equal to or lower to your unarmed strike damage die. You may reduce the damage die tier of your weapons so that they may fit this.

Talents.name: Grudge
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, your tattoos are performing much better, and glowing much brighter purple whenever you can enact your vengeance. You gain Grudge in the following ways.

* +1 Grudge when this creature is hit by a hostile creature
* +1 Grudge when an allied creature is hit by a hostile creature

If a hostile creature was inflicted with vengeance/vendetta mark when they hit you or an allied creature, gain +1 Grudge.

**Grudge**

Deal extra damage equal to half of the effect stack to an enemy with Vengeance or Vendetta mark (Max +5). Max Stack: 15

Some features will allow you to consume Grudge. For every 5 Grudge consumed, gain one stack of Middle Augmentation Tattoo.

**Middle Augment Tattoo**

Gain 1 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` per stack. If the damage has the Envy affinity, add an additional +1 to the damage rolls per stack. Max Stack: 3

Talents.name: Write 'em all Down
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, you’ve spent enough time with the middle to strategically hunt down enemies of the middle. When a hostile creature deals damage to you or an allied creature that you can see, they are inflicted with Vengeance Mark. While a target is inflicted with Vengeance Mark, `Clash::Clashing` rolls against them increase by one dice tier. Upon reaching 10th level, your Vengeance Mark changes to Vendetta Mark. A Vendetta Mark has the same effects as Vengeance Mark and additionally adds +1d6 damage to all sources.

I will get you back for this, man.

At 6th level, whenever you or your ally within 5 feet of you gets hit by an enemy, you can make an Opportunity attack against them. You can consume 5 Grudge stacks on yourself to make an additional unarmed strike as a part of the same reaction. You may only do this once per reaction.

Talents.name: Multifold Retribution
Talents.desc: At 10th level, spending time in Middle and intensive training taught you how to light up your augments whenever you're close to getting hit. Whenever an attack made by an enemy marked with Vendetta mark hits you, you can use your reaction to gain an amount of temporary hit points equal to your level before the damage is dealt and use the "I will get you back for this, man." feature as a part of the same reaction. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and recover all of this feature's usages at the end of a long rest.

Talents.name: Vengeance for All
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you’ve been given a more stylish book of vengeance, one that allows for more marks to be given. When reducing a creature to 0 hit points who was marked with a vengeance or vendetta mark, you may then choose to move up to your movement speed and make a single unarmed strike against a creature within range.

Talents.name: A Just Vengeance
Talents.desc: At 17th level, if you're using "I'll get you back for this, man." feature, you can make amount of opportunity attacks equal to the number of attacks you can make with your Attack action. Additionally, you can spend 4 Grudge stacks to make an additional Unarmed strike up to 3 times. If the enemy has Vendetta Mark, one of your attacks deals additional damage equal to the roll of the same amount of your Unarmed strike dice as the amount of Middle Augment Tattoo stacks on self. (e.g if you have 4 Augment Tattoo stacks, one of your attacks deal additional 4d12 damage).

Talents.name: As the Prescripts Command
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you’ve been chosen by the prescripts and accepted into the Index, one of the five most powerful syndicates in the world and with that you have begun to learn their techniques. Upon entering combat gain Prescript 1 and a random hostile creature gains Mark of the Prescript. If a creature with Mark of the Prescript dies, another random hostile creature gains Mark of the Prescript.

* Prescript 1 (0 Grace of the Prescripts): Make an attack roll or impose a saving throw on a creature marked with Mark of the Prescript.
* Prescript 2 (3 Grace of the Prescripts): Deal damage to a marked hostile creature.
* Prescript 3 (6 Grace of the Prescripts): Deal at least 10 damage in a single attack or feature, or use an E.G.O. skill against a marked hostile creature.
* Prescript 4 (9 Grace of the Prescripts): Eliminate all hostile creatures before the next Prescript arrives (This just means you are fully buffed.)

**Mark of the Prescript**

Marked creature gains 1 `Defense Level down::Defense Level Down`. Marked Creature has a -2 penalty to clash checks against creatures who use Index features.

Upon performing a prescripts command, gain 1d4-1 Grace of the Prescript (minimum of 1) and gain a +1d4 to attack rolls and `Clash::Clashing` rolls until the end of your next turn. Upon reaching a new threshold of Grace of the Prescript, gain the next prescript at the beginning of your next turn. You gain a new prescript at each of the values listed on the Prescript list. Failure to perform a prescript by the end of your turn grants the user 5 Karmic Consequence.

**Grace of the Prescript**

Gain +1 to attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and AC for every 3 stacks.

**Max Stacks: 9**

**Karmic Consequence**

Gain 1 Defense Level Down for every 10 stacks.

Upon reaching Prescript 4, the marked target only changes upon the inflicted creature being reduced to 0 hit points. After which, the nearest hostile creature to the previously marked target is marked with Mark of the Prescript.

Talents.name: Binding Chains
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you may force a creature within 20 feet of you to make a strength or dexterity saving throw by throwing chains at them. On a failed save, the creature will take 2d8 bludgeoning damage, be restrained and you may pull the creature towards you. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage. A creature may attempt to escape these chains as an attack or an action, making the save again, breaking free on a success and staying chained on a failure. You may use this feature once per long or short rest. At 10th level you may use this feature twice per long rest, and thrice per long rest at 17th level. You may regain a use of this feature by expending 4 light. This feature deals increased damage as you increase in level, going to 2d10 at level 6, 2d12 at level 10, 4d6 at 13th level and 4d8 at 17th level. This feature gains 10ft to its range at levels 6, 10, 13 and 17 each.

Talents.name: The Messenger
Talents.desc: At 6th level, when landing an attack roll against a creature marked with Mark of the Prescripts, inflict 4 `Sinking::Sinking` on them.

Talents.name: Prescript Device
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, the index has granted you a new means of receiving prescripts in the form of a small device. For every prescript that you successfully fulfil and move on from, gain 1 Unlock (Ex: After moving from Prescript 1 to Prescript 2, gain 1 Unlock). While under the effects of unlock, gain the following benefits.

**Unlock**

Gain 1 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`. You may only gain 1 Unlock per prescript level Max Stack: 3

Additionally, you no longer need to roll to determine how many stacks of Grace of the prescripts you receive and instead receive 3 at a time. You may still only gain Grace of the Prescripts once per turn.

Talents.name: Proper Praise
Talents.desc: At 13th level, after moving to the next prescript, gain 1 `offense level up::Offense Level Up` until the end of your next turn. Upon reaching Prescript 4, gain 2 offense level up until the end of combat.

Talents.name: Full Release
Talents.desc: At 17th level, while under the effects of Unlock, gain an additional +1 to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws per stack. Additionally, after completing a prescript gain a 1d6 to all attack rolls and clash rolls until the end of your next turn instead of 1d4.

Talents.name: Class and Respect
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you’ve been accepted into the `Thumb::The Thumb, Melee Variant`, one of the five most powerful syndicates in the world. Upon joining you are given a standard issue rifle with a bayonet attached. The Thumb’s primary form of combat is marksmanship and bayonet combat and as such you gain the Gun Brawler `fighting style::Fighting Style` but instead of unarmed strikes and pistols, it counts for any weapon of the Thumb. The rifle deals 1d10 piercing damage and has a range of 80/120ft with an ammo capacity of 8 rounds. The bayonet deals 1d8 slashing damage and can only be used while within 5ft of a target. Reloading the rifle takes a bonus action for 2 rounds, or an action for all 8.

Talents.name: Bayonet Combat
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, your weapon generates energy, allowing your bullets to take on additional effects. When making a melee attack with your bayonet, roll a 1d4. On a roll of 1-3 you gain a special ammo type listed in the table below. On a roll of a 4, you may choose the type. When making a ranged attack roll, you may choose to exchange the bullet for any of the rounds you have acquired over combat. When entering combat you have no High tech rounds, however outside of combat it is treated as all special ammo is infinite, only requiring you to use a singular piece of ammo to carry out it’s additional effects.

* 1: Flame Ammunition: On hit, inflict an amount of burn equal to twice your PB+1.
* 2: Frost Ammunition: On hit, deal 1d4 extra cold damage and inflict 1 `Bind::Bind` and 1 Paralyze.
* 3 Armor-piercing Ammunition: On hit, inflict 2 `Fragile::Fragile`. The initial attack roll also ignores 2 AC of the target that is from armour, strength or constitution.

Talents.name: Shock Round
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you may combine the energy of two special pieces of ammo to cause a large concussive blast against a target. As an action for any 3 special ammo, you may make an attack against a target within 60ft. This special attack takes on the additional effects of any ammo consumed to make this attack. On hit, the target takes twice your weapon damage and must make a constitution saving throw. On failure the target loses 2 reactions, gains 3 `Bind::Bind` and has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws until the end of their next turn. If you are 11th Level, this feature instead deals thrice your weapon damage.

Talents.name: Suppressive Fire
Talents.desc: At 10th level, you’ve needed to cover for some allies who are far more challenged in ranged combat than yourself. As an action for any 2 special ammo, you may make an attack action against a target within 60ft. This special attack action does not take on the additional effects of any ammo consumed to make this attack. On hit, the next ally that attacks them will have advantage on all attack rolls until the end of their turn or will impose disadvantage on saving throws they impose.

Talents.name: Focus Fire
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you find yourself leaving combat with more specialized rounds than you knew what to do with, it would be a shame to see them go to waste. As a bonus action after making the attack action, you may discard all available specialized ammo to attack a single target. You may make an attack roll for every single bullet expended in this way, adding any additional effects they grant. You cannot use this ability outside of combat. You may use this feature once per short or long rest.

Talents.name: Discipline
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you've risen to the top of your ranks and become a figure of respect, and with that comes discipline. Once per short or long rest you may as an action, target one creature within 5ft of you. On hit you deal 2d8+Strength or Dexterity bludgeoning damage and knock the opponent prone. After being knocked prone you may follow up with five attacks of your choosing. Ranged attacks performed in this way do not gain disadvantage while the target is prone, instead gaining advantage. Additionally, you may use your reaction to target any prone creature and make three attacks against them. Using Discipline in this way still uses your usage of the feature.

Talents.name: Class and Respect
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you’ve been accepted into the Thumb, one of the five most powerful syndicates in the world. Upon joining you are given a martial melee weapon of your choice that deals slashing or piercing damage and lacks the two-handed property. This weapon is considered a workshop weapon for any future upgrades or augments. It does gain the below benefit without using an augment point.

* Balanced Blade: When landing a melee weapon attack using a slashing or piercing damage weapon, inflict 2 `tremor::Tremor` count per hit. At 10th level, inflict 3 tremor instead.

Talents.name: Propellant Ammunition
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, your melee weapon has been provided an upgrade with an attachment to hold specialized cartridges that help propel the blade when making attacks. As part of a weapon attack you may expend one propellant ammunition to add 1d6 fire damage to the weapons damage and inflict `burn::Burn` stacks equal to the fire damage dealt. When landing a hit powered by Propellant Ammunition, you may `burst tremor::Tremor Burst`. This damage increases to 1d8 at 3rd level, 1d10 at 6th level, 1d12 at 10th level, 2d6 at 13th level and 2d8 at 17th level.

You have a number of Propellant Ammo equal to your proficiency bonus per short or long rest. Twice per short or long rest, as a full turn action, you may reload your Propellant Ammo.

Talents.name: Textbook Bladework
Talents.desc:
At 3th level, learning the art of melee combat through the Thumb has lead to your textbook efficiency in melee combat. You gain the following benefits.

When engaged in a clash, you may add the sum of (`Tremor::Tremor` count + `Burn::Burn` Count) / 2 on the target up to a maximum of half of your level to clash rolls you make. Additionally, you may expend a Propellant round in order to add the damage to your clash roll and apply that rolled amount of burn automatically, regardless of a clash win or lose.

Talents.name: Specialized Rounds
Talents.desc:
At 6th level, you’ve been granted specialized propellant ammunition for your continued growth under the Thumb. Choose one of the following options, this choice cannot be changed later.

Tigermark Rounds: Propellant Ammunition extra damage increases by 2 tiers. Additionally, When spending a Tigermark Round on a creature inflicted with `Tremor::Tremor`, `Amplitude Conversion::Amplitude Conversion` to Tremor Scorch.

Acceleration Rounds: When spending Acceleration Rounds, gain poise equal half of the Acceleration Round’s additional damage. Additionally, when using Acceleration Rounds, you may convert a single attack that has advantage into an additional attack as part of your attack action. You may only gain an additional attack from this feature once per turn.

Finally, when spending either a Tigermark or Acceleration round on a target who has 20 or more tremor, `burst tremor::Tremor Burst`.

Talents.name: Superheated Blade
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, the extended use of propellant ammunition has overheated the blade from repeated use. After running out of propellant ammunition, your weapon becomes superheated and gains the following benefits.

* Inflict +2 `Burn::Burn` on hit.
* Inflict `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` when landing an attack against a creature with +20 `Tremor::Tremor`.
* +1 to attack and damage rolls.
* Increase damage dice tier by 1.

This condition ends if you regain any rounds or at the end of combat.

Talents.name: Single Out
Talents.desc:
At 13th level, you’ve found efficient ways to single out your targets. After taking the attack action and only hitting one creature with all of your attacks, you may inflict them with Prey. Only one creature may have Prey at a time, and applying it again removes the condition from the previous creature.

**Prey**

Inflicted creatures suffer a penalty to their clash checks against you equal to your Strength or Dexterity modifier (Max -5). You gain a +2 bonus to your attack and damage rolls against creatures inflicted with prey, and you may dash towards them as a bonus action. If you could already dash as a bonus action, you instead move 30ft farther with this bonus action dash.

Talents.name: Roaring Tiger
Talents.desc: At 17th level, the difference between you and your enemies is night and day, and you will show it.
