Winning a `Clash::Clashing` - Stall or Clash - Counter refunds the light spent on it, and winning a Clash - Stall or Clash - Counter refunds your reaction. You may reload your Propellant rounds as a bonus action rather than a full turn action, or for free when you are `staggered::Staggered`, stunned or paralyzed, removing the condition from yourself. You may still only reload twice per short or long rest.

Talents.name: Corpus Artwork
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you have picked your taste in artwork, although outdated, you find it to be the purist form of art.

You will gain a Corpus Weapon, this weapon can be based on any weapon you would like, and can be upgraded based on the features of this subclass. You will automatically have proficiency with the Corpus Weapon, No matter what kind of weapon you base it off of, you will inflict 2 `Bleed::Bleed` on hit with it. This weapon can be upgraded like a workshop weapon, and does not lose augmentation points for being a Fixer Tool. An example augmentation for this weapon can be dealing an extra 4 Bleed when hitting a non-bleeding enemy.

Talents.name: Gathering Ingredients
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, you have begun to extract ingredients for your Corpus Art from people during combat. There are three Corpus Ingredients you can collect. All ingredients expire after 24 hours of collecting them, apart from Corpus Ingredient - Bones, which you can keep 1 stack of.

**Corpus Ingredient - Blood**

You may have a maximum of 5 of this ingredient. When hitting a creature that has at least 5 `Bleed::Bleed` with a corpus weapon melee attack, you can consume up to 25 Bleed on the creature, and gain 1 Corpus Ingredient - Blood for every 5 Bleed Consumed. You may spend Corpus Ingredient - Blood to deal +1 DMG on attack for every ingredient spent.

**Corpus Ingredient - Flesh**

You may have a maximum of 15 of this ingredient. When hitting a creature, you can consume 5 Corpus Ingredient - Blood or 2 `Light::Light` to force the creature to make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Fixer DC. If they fail, you may inflict (Attack DMG Dealt / 2, Max 10) Bleed and gain 2 Corpus Ingredient - Flesh, or 3 if you had used Corpus Ingredient - Blood rather than Light. Gain a +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls for every 5 Corpus Ingredient - Flesh you have.

**Corpus Ingredient - Bones**

You may have a maximum of 3 of this ingredient. When within 5 feet of a dead humanoid creature, you may make a DC (12 + Creatures CON Mod) Survival Check to extract the bones out of the corpse, giving you 1 Corpus Ingredient - Bones. Before rolling an attack roll, You may consume 1 Corpus Ingredient - Bones to gain a +4 to the DMG Roll of the attack.

Talents.name: Corpus Refinement
Talents.desc:
At 6th level, you have refined your Corpus Arts to a new level. Your Corpus Weapon damage dice upgrades by 1 tier, and inflict 1 Additional `Bleed::Bleed` on hit. Additionally, you may now consume 1 Corpus Ingredient - Flesh with no action cost at the start of your turn to gain 6 Temp HP.

At 13th Level, your Corpus Weapon damage dice gets upgraded by an additional tier, On Hit inflicts 2 additional bleed instead of 1 (4 Total Bleed), and gains 10 Temp HP from consuming Flesh ingredients instead of 6.

Additionally, you may choose one of the following buffs to apply to your Corpus Weapon.

* Tendon Chords: Melee weapons gain +5 feet of range. Ranged weapons increase both short and long range by 30 feet.
* Wrapped Carotid Artery: Gain a +1 to Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls.
* Perfectly Severed Bones: Split your Corpus Weapon into 2 Light Melee Weapons, which allow you to use a bonus action to attack. If the Corpus Weapon already has Light, then you cannot choose this feature. The damage dice on the Corpus Weapons are lowered by 2 Tiers and their Bleed Infliction is lowered by 1.
* Pumping Blood Vessels: The Corpus Weapons inflicts +2 Bleed.

**Masterpiece in Progress**

You are on the path to creating your masterpiece. At 10th level, if there is a dead creature within 5 feet of you, you may consume all ingredients to create a Corpus Anamakin. The Corpus Anamakin stat sheet is strengthened based on the amount of Ingredients put into it. You may command 2 Anamakins in combat with you, with no action required. Anamakins that do not have a command while in combat will simply take the dodge action and defend themselves without attacking. At your DM's discretion, you may send these Anamakins to do tasks past this 2 Anamakin limit, but only if you send them without you or your other party members.

* AC: 15 + Bones
* Hit Points: 25 + (Flesh * Player Proficiency Bonus) + (CON MOD * Player Proficiency Bonus)
* Speed: 35 ft.

(These cannot go above 22)

* STR: 8 + Player Proficiency Bonus
* DEX: 8 + Player Proficiency Bonus + Blood
* CON: 8 + Player Proficiency Bonus + (Flesh / 3)
* INT: 2
* WIS: 5
* CHA: 2

Muscular Contraction: If a target of an attack has 8+ Bleed, Gain a +1 to attack rolls and +3 to damage rolls.

**Actions**

Multiattack: Corpus Anamakin makes two Vascular Tear attacks.

**Vascular Tear**

Melee Attack Roll: +DEX+PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On Hit, Deal 1d4 + DEX Piercing damage for every Bones (does not increase the DEX added) and Inflict (Blood / 2, Max 2) Bleed.

* Blood = Blood put into the Anamakin
* Flesh = Flesh put into the Anamakin
* Bones = Bones put into the Anamakin

Talents.name: Perfected Harvesting
Talents.desc:
At 13th level, you can claim Ingredients faster and more efficiently. Your ingredients are enhanced, and gain the following buffs.

**Corpus Ingredient - Blood**

Max Stack 5 -> 9 | You now gain +1 Blood on hit.

**Corpus Ingredient - Flesh**

Max Stack 15 -> 20 | At 10+ Flesh, your Corpus Weapon is considered magical to bypass resistances and inflicts +1 `Bleed::Bleed`.

**Corpus Ingredient - Bones**

Max Stack 3 -> 5 | When consuming Bones for an attack, increase the Damage Dice Tier by the amount of bones spent.

Talents.name: Corpus Masterpiece
Talents.desc:
At 17th level, you have perfected the craft of Corpus, your Corpus Anamakin now becomes a Corpus Masterpiece.

* AC: 17 + Bones
* Hit Points: 75 + (Flesh * Player Proficiency Bonus) + (CON MOD * Player Proficiency Bonus)
* Speed: 45 ft.

(These cannot go above 22)

* STR: 10 + Player Proficiency Bonus + Blood
* DEX: 10 + Player Proficiency Bonus + Blood
* CON: 10 + Player Proficiency Bonus + (Flesh / 2)
* INT: 2
* WIS: 5
* CHA: 2

**Traits**

Muscular Contraction: If a target of an attack has 8+ `Bleed::Bleed`, Gain a +2 to attack rolls and +5 to damage rolls.

**Actions**

Multiattack: Corpus Anamakin makes three Vascular Tear attacks.

**Vascular Tear**

Melee Attack Roll: +DEX+PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On Hit, Deal 2d4 + DEX Piercing damage (does not increase the DEX added) for every Bones and Inflict (Blood) Bleed.

* Blood = Blood put into the Masterpiece
* Flesh = Flesh put into the Masterpiece
* Bones = Bones put into the Masterpiece

Talents.name: Art Medium
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you begin your journey into the arts of the city. You may choose your designated Paint, you may only choose one type of paint.

* Red Paint: `Bleed::Bleed`
* Orange Paint: `Burn::Burn`
* Yellow Paint: `Tremor::Tremor`
* Green Paint: `Rupture::Rupture`
* Blue Paint: `Sinking::Sinking`

Upon hitting a creature with a melee attack, you will inflict 2 of the chosen Paint Type's Status Effect, and roll 1d6 and inflict 2 of a status effect based on the table below.

* 1 | Burn
* 2 | Bleed
* 3 | Tremor
* 4 | Rupture
* 5 | Sinking
* 6 | Paint Type

If the Pointillist Table inflicts the same type of status effect as your Paint Type, inflict an additional +(Proficiency Bonus - 1) of the associated effect.

Talents.name: Dotting
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your painting begins to make you stronger in combat. When attacking a creature with the status effect associated with your Paint Type, gain a +1 to attack rolls for every 6 of the status effect (Max 2). If your Paint Type is Blue, Red or Orange, you can gain the buff for every 4 of the status effect instead of 6, as they expire quickly. You may consume 10 stacks of `Tremor::Tremor` or `Rupture::Rupture` on a creature to change your Paint Type to Yellow or Green respectively, and you may consume 5 stacks of `Burn::Burn`, `Bleed::Bleed` or `Sinking::Sinking` to change your Paint Type to Orange, Red or Blue respectively.

Talents.name: Paint Over
Talents.desc: At 6th level, when inflicting your Paint Type status effect with a melee attack, inflict double of the Status Effect. At 13th level, inflict triple of the Status Effect.

Talents.name: Sanguine Pointillism
Talents.desc: At 10th level, after hitting an attack roll against a creature, you may roll a d10. This d10 gains a bonus to the roll for every type of negative effect on the target. If the d10 roll above a 7, you may make a free attack action against the target creature. You may use this feature (Proficiency Bonus - 2, Max 3) times per turn.

Talents.name: Artwork Inspection
Talents.desc: At 13th level, when dealing damage to a creature that has negative status effect, deal +1 DMG for every 8 total negative status effect (15 `Tremor::Tremor`, 6 `Bleed::Bleed`, 3 `Rupture::Rupture` = +3 DMG). The status effect that is associated with your Paint Type counts as doubled when checking your damage bonus with this feature (6 `Sinking::Sinking` = 12 Sinking for the purposes of this feature). This extra damage cannot exceed an amount equal to double your proficiency bonus.

Talents.name: Hematic Coloring
Talents.desc: At 17th level, upon hitting a creature, for 3 `Light::Light`, you may inflict Curio onto the target. Creatures with Curio have negative effects doubled in effectiveness (When taking 3 `Bleed::Bleed` Damage, Take 6 Instead). There can only be 1 creature in combat with Curio at a time. Upon the creature with Curio dying, you will gain a stack of Exquisite Aesthetics. For every stack of Exquisite Aesthetics, gain +2 to Attack Roll, Damage Rolls, and Status infliction. Lose all Exquisite Aesthetics at the end of combat. You may have up to 3 Exquisite Aesthetics at maximum.

Talents.name: Singular Focus of the Mind
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you gain the Iajutsu `fighting style::Fighting Style`. At the end of your turn, you may sheathe your blade as a free action. When sheathing your blade, gain 2 `Poise::Poise` count at the start of your next turn. After sheathing your blade, you may convert any amount of poise up to your Dexterity modifier + Proficiency bonus into Moonlit Azure Blade.

**Moonlit Azure Blade**

* This shield gains hit points at the start of your turn equal to double the stacks of Moonlit Azure Blade. Moonlit Azure Blade is a separate health pool, in the same way as the Abjuration Wizard's ability. Attacks that only deal damage to this ward count as having missed you. This ward does not work against psychic or status effect damage.
* Max Stacks: 10

Your maximum stack of Moonlit Azure Blade increases to 15 at 5th level, 20 at 11th level and 25 at 17th level.

Additionally, when taking the dodge action you gain +4 Poise. After taking the dodge action with 5 Moonlit Azure Blade, you may make a single weapon attack as a bonus action. At 6th level, gain +5 Poise when taking the dodge action, and at 10th level, gain +6 Poise.

Talents.name: Swerve [回]
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, after taking the dodge action, gain +1 `poise::Poise` every time an attack misses you or you succeed a dexterity saving throw. When taking the attack action, gain +2 Poise count once all attacks from the attack action are resolved. At 6th level, gain 1 Poise after you critically hit, and at 10th level, gain 2 Poise after you critically hit.

Talents.name: Nameless Slash [無名斬]
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you may spend 5 Moonlit Azure Blade to make a bonus action attack without needing to take the dodge action. All bonus action attacks are now considered Nameless Slash [無名斬] attacks. When landing a critical hit with Nameless Slash [無名斬], you may roll weapon damage an additional time and add it to the total. If at 10 or more stacks of Moonlit Azure Blade before making the attack roll, add an additional roll of damage to the total of Nameless Slash [無名斬].

Talents.name: Bladetrail
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, when landing a critical hit on a creature, inflict them with Bladetrail equal to the `Poise::Poise` consumed when landing the critical.

**Bladetrail**

* A creature inflicted with Bladetrail gains 1 `Fragile::Fragile` at the start of their turns for every 5 Bladetrail stacks they have. Fragile inflicted in this way lasts until the start of their next turn. When you attack creatures with Bladetrail, you also treat half of their Fragile stacks from this feature as `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down`.
* Max Stack: 50

A creature may attempt to reduce Bladetrail stacks by clashing against you. When a creature wins a clash against you, they halve their stacks of Bladetrail.

Talents.name: Fallstar Slayer [落星一殺]
Talents.desc: At 13th level, when using Nameless Slash [無名斬], you may choose to make an attack roll against up to two additional creatures within half of your movement speed without needing to be within melee range. On hit deal weapon damage and you may allocate your additional damage rolls from Nameless Slash [無名斬] to any creature you landed an attack roll on using Fallstar Slayer [落星一殺]. You may choose to remove a target to give the remaining attacks 2 stacks of `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`, to a maximum of 4 Offense Level Up on one target. This expends an additional 5 Moonlit Azure Blade.

Talents.name: Rend Space
Talents.desc: At 17th level, as an action you may spend all Moonlit Azure Blade stacks on self to make a single powerful attack. On hit consume all Bladetrail on the target and deal (weapon damage x 3) + Bladetrail stacks consumed as weapon damage. If 20 Moonlit Azure Blade was consumed, this attack becomes a critical hit. If you had 25+ `Poise::Poise` when making this attack, do not roll damage, instead deal maximum damage.

Talents.name: Deckhand
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you’ve been recruited by the Pequod Crew, a band of pirates sailing the seas of U-Corp. Your training grants you proficiency in any tools necessary to upkeep a ship in addition to a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Additionally, you gain proficiency in using harpoons, hooks, spears, and anchors for the sake of weapons if you did not already. The range of throwing weapons is doubled for you. Finally, when you are wielding a weapon that deals piercing or slashing damage, you inflict 3 `bleed::Bleed` on a successful hit.

Talents.name: Vicious Attacks
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your training in dealing with the monsters of the great lakes has made you experienced at impeding movement and causing debilitating pain. Once per turn, when you land an attack with a slashing or piercing weapon against a creature, you may inflict 1 `Bind::Bind`. When hitting a creature that is afflicted by bind, gain 2 `poise::Poise`. Landing a critical hit with a piercing weapon inflicts 4 `Bleed::Bleed` and 1 Bind, and landing a crit with a slashing weapon inflicts only 3 Bleed. You may only apply a maximum of 3 Bind on your turn when using this feature.

Talents.name: Sailor's Grit
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your constant use of sharp tools and the sway of the boat beneath your feet give you better chances of surviving than those new fellas. You now crit on 19-20 and you have advantage on saves against charmed, frightened and being knocked prone. When being knocked prone, you may expend your reaction to choose to not be, digging your weapon into the ground. When you would be forcefully moved, you may roll the damage of your weapon as a reaction, reducing the distance you are knocked back by that amount rounded to the nearest 5.You gain an additional reaction that may only be used for this affiliation's features.

Talents.name: Sweep The Deck
Talents.desc: At 10th level, when you critically hit a creature, or by expending 1 light when hitting a creature, you may force a creature to make a strength saving throw, being knocked prone on a failure. Attacks against prone creatures have a +1 to their critical hit range. Additionally, when you apply bind, you now also apply `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down`.

Talents.name: Right Hand
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you’ve moved up the ranks and become a true asset to your crew. Friendly creatures have advantage on intelligence, wisdom and charisma saving throws while within 60ft of you. When you critically hit, you may use your reaction to allow a friendly creature to move up to their movement speed and make an attack against the creature that you had critically hit, or you may choose to make the attack yourself by spending 1 light. You gain an additional reaction that may only be used for this affiliation's features.

Talents.name: Pequod Captain
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you’ve risen to the top and now control the battlefield like it is your own vessel. Your presence makes your crew roar with adoration and respect, and when you order, they follow. When friendly creatures within 60ft of you would take psychic damage, you may choose to halve that damage, taking half of it yourself. Additionally, when you or a friendly creature lands a critical hit, all friendly creatures within 60ft gain 2 `poise::Poise`. If you or a friendly creature kill a creature, all friendly creatures within 60ft gain 5 poise. You, and all allies within 60ft, may add double your charisma modifier to saving throws against being charmed or frightened. If you would be charmed or frightened, you may instead take an amount of psychic damage equal to the DC of the saving throw and shrug off the effect. You may use an action for 4 light in order to bellow a roaring order to your crew, removing the frightened and charmed conditions from friendly creatures within 120ft of you, and making them ignore the effects of exhaustion for the next minute. While this effect is active, they gain an `offense level up::Offense Level Up`, a `defense level up::Defense Level Up` and 2 `haste::Haste`.

Talents.name: Nonstop Scavengers
Talents.desc: At 1st level, your experience in the outskirts has weathered your body, but has improved your ability to travel as a group. Your hit dice is reduced to 1d6. You do not suffer exhaustion while traveling and you only require half of the time to take short and long rests and you recover all hit points on a short rest. Finally, you gain pack tactics. When an ally attacks a creature within your movement speed, you may move up to your movement speed towards that creature as a reaction.

Talents.name: Health Hauler
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you need to keep living at any cost, even at the expense of others. When successfully landing an attack against a target and deal the maximum amount of damage on the dice roll, you recover 2 hit points.

Talents.name: Trash Disposal
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you’ll never stop attacking until you’re unable to move. When dealing max damage on the dice roll of your weapon attack, you may make an additional attack that automatically hits. You may make a max of 2 additional attacks this way. You may only use this feature once every round.

Talents.name: Harvest
Talents.desc: At 10th level, bodies are like rewards for your hard work, so why let them go to waste. While within 5ft of a body, you may as an action pulverize the body and recover 8d4+prof hit points. Additionally, you no longer need to hit max damage to benefit from health hauler and now only need to deal damage in separate instances. This does not apply after the 2nd extra attack.

At 13th level, nothing will stop you from moving, nothing at all. When reduced to 0 hit points, roll a 1d4. On a result of 4, you come back with 25% of your maximum hit points. You can however increase these odds. Whenever you land a critical hit, your chance increases by an additional result (ex: with one critical hit your chance to return to 25% hit points now occurs on roll of a 3-4). This feature occurs every single time you are reduced to 0 hit points unless you are over-killed or killed outright. Finally, when using this feature more than once, your increased chance of returning to 25% hit points is reset and will require you to rebuild the chance.

Talents.name: Sweep The Earth
Talents.desc: At 17th level, your grit has led you this far, and you’re not going to let it stop now. When using your Trash Disposal feature, your attack cap increases to 10. Additionally, you may now make damage rolls at advantage, and you deal a flat extra 2 damage when attacking a creature while under the effects of pack tactics.

Talents.name: Swashbucklers
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you have learned the unique `fighting style::Fighting Style` of the Twin Hooks. You gain the following benefits:

* You do not have disadvantage when making ranged attacks within 5ft with pistols
* When wielding a pistol, you may choose to make a single attack as an action. On hit with this attack you gain 2 `poise::Poise` before the attack roll.
* Melee attacks inflict 1 `bleed::Bleed`. On critical hit with a melee weapon inflict 3 bleed instead.

Talents.name: Bullets are Pricey
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, after dealing damage to a bleeding target, gain 1 Unjust Enrichment. Landing a critical hit against a bleeding target grants 3 Unjust Enrichment instead.

Upon landing a critical hit with a ranged attack from a pistol, you may choose to expend all Unjust Enrichment to deal an additional dice of damage for every 2 Unjust Enrichment. This additional damage is not doubled by the initial critical hit.

Talents.name: Two Sides Of a Coin
Talents.desc: At 6th level, after landing an attack roll, gain 1 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` next turn. On attack miss, gain 2 `poise::Poise`.

Talents.name: Foregone Conclusion
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, when making a ranged weapon attack within 5ft of the target creature, increase crit range to 18-20. Additionally. Ranged attacks with a pistol deal an additional dice of damage.

When using the Swashbuckler feature to make a single ranged attack, that attack’s damage is equal to (weapon’s base damage x number of attacks you can make on an attack action). Any attacks that can be made as a bonus action or from an offhand weapon do not apply to the damage of attacks made using Foregone Conclusion.

Talents.name: Huzzah!
Talents.desc:
At 13th level, when landing a critical hit, up to two allies of your choice gain +1d4 to their next attack rolls until the end of their next turn.

If using sanity variant rules, gain +15 sanity when landing a critical hit and up to two allies of your choice gain +10 sanity.

Talents.name: Symphony to Destruction
Talents.desc: At 17th level, start all combat encounters with 5 Unjust Enrichment. Upon killing a creature, gain 5 Unjust Enrichment. Increase all bleed inflicted by +2. Finally, when expending 25 Unjust Enrichment, gain 2 `offense level up::Offense Level Up`.

Talents.name: Unforgettable Melody
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you’ve been graced by the piano man’s melody and with that you aspire to create something even remotely as beautiful. As a bonus action you may begin a performance as you dance as you fight, your weapon humming with music every swing. Allied creatures who start their turn within 30ft of you gain 1 `Haste::Haste` and 1 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`. This range is counted as your performance range.

Talents.name: Inspire the Masses
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, slowly but surely, your music has inspired your crack one more person’s skull a day. For no action cost, once on your turn, you may grant an allied creature within your performance range a Bremen dice. That creature may add this to any roll of their choice for the next 10 minutes. The dice size is a 1d6 and increases in size at 10th level to a 1d8, and again at 17th level to a 1d10. You have a number of these dice equal to your charisma modifier (min 1). If you have the Abnormally Awesome feature, you gain extra dice equal to your proficiency bonus.

Talents.name: The Red Notes
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you have become the musician, and the body is an instrument for you to manipulate. As an bonus action you may make an charisma based attack action with proficiency, targeting a creatures tendons to pluck for a note. On hit the target will take a roll of your bardic inspiration dice of thunder or psychic damage (your choice) and suffer the opposite effects of your active performance until the end of their next turn. For example, at this level, it would give them 1 `Bind::Bind`, 1 `Offense Level Down::Offense Level Down`, and give them a -1d6 to all of their attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws until the end of their next turn. These effects cannot stack, but hitting a consecutive attack with this ability applies 1 `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down`.

Talents.name: Courageous Performance
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your performances seem to take the stress away. All friendly creatures within your performance cannot be frightened. If a friendly unit enters your performance’s range while frightened, the condition is removed from them. Your Unforgettable Melody radius increases to 60ft.

Talents.name: Improved Performance
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, you’ve improved your skills and your dancing in tow. Your Unforgettable Melody radius increases to 120ft. With that you gain additional effects of your choice to your performance feature that friendly units within your Unforgettable Melody range will gain.

* Bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier
* Bonus to attack rolls equal to your Charisma modifier
* Friendly units may disengage as a free action.

Talents.name: Empowering Song
Talents.desc: At 13th level, your performance has become an area of weakness to your enemies. All allies within your performance's range gain 1 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`, 1 `Haste::Haste` and 1 `Defense Level Up::Defense Level Up`.

Talents.name: Symphony to Destruction
Talents.desc: At 17th level, your performance has been perfected and with it your small party of 4 can fight like an army of 40. When granting Bremen Dice to an ally, not only do they gain your performance’s benefits on their next turn regardless if they are in range of it or not, but they may also make an additional weapon attack when taking the attack action until the end of their next turn. Your Unforgettable Melody range increases to 240ft.

Talents.name: Loaded Gun
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you’ve been recruited by the Full Stop Office, a group of mercenaries for hire specializing in firearms. Nowadays guns can be pretty expensive, and money is pretty tight, so you’ve been trained exclusively in one firearm of your choice between a Pistol, SMG, Shotgun or Sniper Rifle. Below are the listed stats for each weapon.

**Pistol: 2d8 piercing damage.**

Range: 30/60ft 12 bullets per magazine Light, Concealable, Does not gain disadvantage when within 5ft.

Quickdraw: Pistol You may add your proficiency bonus to your initiative rolls, and you may draw this pistol with no action cost once per round.

**SMG: 1d8/2d6 piercing damage.**

30 bullets per magazine Range: 40/80ft Versatile, Spray.

Spray: SMG You may choose to make an additional attack on your turn, but not add your proficiency bonus to any of your attacks that turn. You may also choose to expend 12 Bullets in order to force all creatures in a 60ft cone to make a dexterity saving throw, taking your weapon damage on a failure, and half as much on a failure.

**Shotgun: 2d12 piercing damage.**

10 bullets per magazine Range: 15/60ft Two-Handed, Unwieldy, Does not gain disadvantage when within 5ft

Unwieldy: Shotgun You have a 5ft slower movement speed.

**Sniper Rifle: 4d8 piercing damage.**

5 bullets per magazine Range: 120/300ft Heavy, Two-Handed, Take Aim, Unwieldy.

Take Aim: Sniper Rifle You cannot make more than one attack per round and you have a 5ft slower movement speed. You may replace your attacks with an Aim, the first one gives you 10 `Poise::Poise` and Advantage on your next attack, the second one gives you 15 Poise and and the third one gives you 20 Poise and 1 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`. These benefits may transfer to the end of your following turn.

You will need to supply your own ammo for these weapons however. You are supplied with one free magazine worth of ammunition every long rest, every additional magazine will cost 25gp. When reloading your firearm, you do so as an action.

Additionally, you gain +1 Workshop Weapon Augmentation points for this weapon, and it does not take an augment slot, so you may have it, and another workshop weapon.

Talents.name: Specialized Support
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, you’ve become more adept with your weapon of choice and with that you have gained some passives that may help yourself or others in the field. You learn the following techniques depending on your gun type.

**Melee Support: Pistol**

After landing a ranged attack, you may dash as a bonus action and make an attack with a light melee weapon.

**Burst Fire: SMG**

You may gain disadvantage on all of your attacks on your turn to gain an additional attack.

**Recoil: Shotgun**

The first two times you land an attack against a creature in a round, inflict 1 Paralyze and 1 `Bind::Bind`. After that, they instead inflict 1 `Fragile::Fragile` on a hit.

**Perforator: Sniper Rifle**

Once per turn, you may reroll an attack roll with a +2 to hit. Once per round, when landing a critical hit with a sniper rifle, inflict 3 Fragile and 1 `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down`.

**Cover Fire: All Firearms**

As a reaction when an allied creature within your normal weapon range is being attacked, you may impede the attacker so long as they are also in range. The target must make a wisdom saving throw or gain disadvantage on all attack rolls against the creature you are Cover Firing for. You may only give one creature this benefit every round.

Talents.name: Bullseye
Talents.desc: At 6th level, when attacking with a firearm, you crit in rolls of 19-20. Additionally, up to twice per turn, you may gain 3 `Poise::Poise` before making an attack, or 8 Poise if you are using a Sniper.

Talents.name: Improved Support
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, you’ve become more deadly with your weapon of choice, you gain any additional features listed that are applicable to your weapon.

**CQC Shooter: Pistol**

When landing an attack with your pistol, you may make a second attack with an light melee weapon as part of the same attack action. You may both draw this weapon as part of this attack.

**Mag Dump: SMG**

If you use both Spray and Burst Fire, you may make an additional attack in exchange for using 2 extra ammo.

**Shredder: Shotgun**

Attacking a creature with `Fragile::Fragile` or `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down` treats you as having an `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`, and reducing a creature to 0 hit points with a shotgun lets you make an attack against the nearest creature in a straight line behind the creature that died. Once per turn, landing a critical hit inflict 1 Defense Level Down.

**Sniper’s Focus: Sniper**

As a bonus action, you may increase your base crit range by 3, gain 2 Offense Level Up and gain a +3 to your attack rolls for that turn.

**Follow-Up: All Firearms**

As a reaction to an ally landing an attack, you may make a single weapon attack against them.

Additionally, if you have the `Aimed Shots::Aimed Shots` Feat, you may use it without spending light a number of times equal to half your Dexterity modifier rounded up per long rest.

Talents.name: The Aftermarket
Talents.desc:
At 13th level, you’ve finally begun to kit out your gun with attachments from workshops or other retailers. Each of these attachments costs 100gp and you may only use up to 2 attachments at once, otherwise you find your weapon to be too bulky for field use. You may make your own Attachments with DM permission, and it is encouraged to do so.

**Suppressor: all firearms**

Gunshots cannot be heard from a distance further than 15ft.

**Compensator: all firearms**

Gain +1 to attack rolls.

**Improved Sights: all firearms**

increase weapon’s range by 1.5x.

**Laser Sight: all firearms**

You gain a +1 to damage rolls.

**Atelier Logic Adaptor: Snipers**

Allows the user to purchase and use Atelier Logic Ammunition. Atelier Logic Ammunition costs 1000gp per bullet. You may only use one bullet per combat encounter, otherwise your gun would fall apart from the inside from extended use. When loaded and fired, the attack is treated as having 3 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`. You may use 1 Atelier Logic Ammunition for free once per long rest.

Talents.name: Full Stop For Life
Talents.desc:
At 17th level, you’ve completely mastered your firearm and with that comes the benefits. You gain a +2 to all attack and damage rolls with your firearm. When attacking a creature that an allied creature has attacked this turn, gain +1 to attack and damage rolls per allied unit who targeted that creature last turn.

Combo: Full-Stop to Life Once per long rest as an action at more than 20 `Poise::Poise`, you may make an attack action, making an additional melee attack on that action. The first 2 attacks that you make with that inflict 25 `Rupture::Rupture` each, the third applies 2 `Defence Level Down::Defense Level Down` and 2 `Bind::Bind`, and the last attack is unclashable and always critically hits. Alternatively, if you use a Sniper, you instead may choose to take the following feature instead.

AL-HV Pulverisation Round Once per long rest as a full turn action at more than 20 Poise and maximum ammo, you may ready yourself to make an absolutely devastating shot. You gain the maximum benefits of your Take Aim feature, gain 25 Poise and gain an `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`. If you would hit 99 Poise from this, you also deal 1.5x damage with this attack. As an action on your next turn, you may make an attack that always critically hits. After using this feature, consume all ammo in magazine, and become unable to gain Poise or reload for the next round.

Talents.name: District 12 Special Workshop Fuel
Talents.desc: At 1st level, Now that you’re a part of an office, you have gained access to specialized flamethrower-like gauntlets, being able to burn your foes away and unleash devastating blows empowered by flames. Starting at 1st level, you gain a fuel tank that is on your character's back and an amount of fuel equal to your level times 5, this is used to fuel some of your class features, during a short or long rest, you are able to make more fuel recovering half on a short rest and all of it on a long rest. You also gain a pair of large flamethrower-like gauntlets that are connected to your tank which you count as proficient with and you cannot be disarmed of this weapon. When attacking with this weapon, it deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage + strength. 1d6 at 7th level, and finally 1d8 at 15th level.

Talents.name: Ignition
Talents.desc:
Additionally at 1st level, you may use this fuel for multiple features. As an action you may use any of the below features. Additionally, all features that deal fire damage from this subclass inflict `burn::Burn` potency equal to half of the fire damage dealt. Refer to the Statuses Page for how burn works.

* Create Flames: You may use the produced flame cantrip at will, spending 1 fuel for every minute of duration of the flame.
* Pyro Enhancement: You may spend 5 fuel to enhance your gauntlet attacks. For the next minute, add an additional 1d4 fire damage to all gauntlet attacks. This additional fire damage increases by an additional tier if you are under the effects of Overheated Fuel up to a d8. When dealing fire damage this way, inflict burn equal to half the fire damage dealt this way

Talents.name: Flamethrow
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, in an attempt to burn everything caught in the range to cinders you may use any increment of 5 fuel, up to 25 an action to eject flames from your gauntlets in a (Fuel Spent)ft cone and force them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On failure, target creatures take 1d6+an additional number of d6s equal to (fuel spent/5) fire damage and are inflicted with burn equal to half of the fire damage dealt. On a successful save, creatures take half damage and are instead inflicted with half as much burn. If the target has +10 `burn::Burn` on them already, increase the dice tier from d6s to d8s.

Talents.name: Overheated Fuel
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you’ve received an upgraded fuel tank in return for your old one that causes the pressure in the tank to increase the less fuel there is from the heat. When Fuel drops below ½ your tank’s maximum value, you are considered to be under the effects of Overheated Fuel. While under the effects of Overheated fuel, deal +1 damage for every 10 fuel consumed this combat when dealing fire damage (Max up to your proficiency bonus). Additionally, when dealing fire damage while under the effects of Overheated Fuel, increase the dice tier of all fire damage by 1.

Talents.name: I have to keep going…
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your time in the Firefist office has not been easy, and you’ve seen its difficulty firsthand especially with fuel management. As an action you may enter a counter stance as you quickly refuel your tanks. You have a number of refuel dice equal to half of your level, these dice are 1d10. When taking this action, roll any number of these dice but must select the number of dice before rolling any of these dice. Recover the result of this roll as fuel. Regain all refuel dice on a short or long rest.

Talents.name: I'll burn away every last drop of your filthy blood
Talents.desc: At 13th level, when inflicting `burn::Burn` on a target who is already burning, you may add +2 burn potency for every 10 burn they are already inflicting with.

Talents.name: Firefist
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you are ready to burn it all to the ground and know just how to do it. Make an attack roll against a target within 5ft of you. On hit, deal 3x rolls of your gauntlet damage. Then spend any increment of fuel, dealing 1d8 fire damage per 5 fuel spent. After choosing the fuel consumption, cause all creatures within a 15ft cone behind the initial target to make a Dexterity saving throw as if they were being targeted by the Flamethrow feature. On failure, target takes full damage and half as much damage and `burn::Burn` potency on success. On kill of the initial target, inflict it’s burn potency divided evenly to all other creatures caught in the blast. Ex: main target died with 20 burn potency, 2 targets are caught in the 15ft cone blast, both targets are now inflicted with 10 burn potency on top of what they were inflicted due to this feature. You may use this feature twice per long rest.

Talents.name: Koi-Koi [こいこい]
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, when entering combat and at the beginning of your turn, determine your “Suit” by rolling 1d6 twice….

Rolled 1-2 = Pine Crane Suit Rolled 3-4 = Suzuki Grass Suit Rolled 5-6 = Blue Sakura Suit

Roll this twice to gain two suits for the turn, if you already have a Suit from the previous turn, then roll this once. You may then choose one of the Suits to gain a buff until the beginning of your next turn, discarding the unchosen buff unless it is the same Suit as the picked Suit.

Pine Crane Suit: On Hit, Gain 1 Attack Power Up and `Haste::Haste` at the start of your next turn (Once per Turn).

Suzuki Grass Suit: On Hit, Inflict 2 `Tremor::Tremor` and 1 `Bind::Bind` to the target (Twice per Turn).

Blue Sakura Suit: On Hit, Inflict 2 `Sinking::Sinking` (Twice per Turn).

Additionally, you may spend 1 `Light::Light` to reroll both suits in your hand (Once per Turn).

Talents.name: Kōzan [光斬]
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, when hitting an attack roll onto a creature while having the same Suit active as the previous turn, gain 1 Bright [光], up to a maximum at 5 Bright [光].

As a bonus action while at 5 Bright [光], you may activate Kōzan [光斬]. Make an attack roll against a creature. On Hit, deal weapon damage dice * X weapon damage and inflict X `Fragile::Fragile` onto the target, where X is your proficiency bonus. If this attack roll misses or if Kōzan [光斬] is not used on the turn that 5 Bright [光] is gained, lose 2 Bright [光] and gain 1 Attack Power Up until the end of your next turn.

Kōzan [光斬] Cannot benefit from Suit Buffs.

Talents.name: Stacking the Deck
Talents.desc:
At 6th level, your Suits are upgraded to give more benefits.

Pine Crane Suit: On Hit, Gain 1 Attack Power Up, 1 DMG UP and 2 `Haste::Haste` at the start of your next turn (Twice per Turn).

Suzuki Grass Suit: On Hit, Inflict 4 `Tremor::Tremor` and 2 `Bind::Bind` to the target.

Blue Sakura Suit: On Hit, Inflict 2 `Sinking::Sinking` and gain 1 Bright [光] (Max 1 Bright [光] per turn)

Talents.name: Floral Deck
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, when using Kōzan [光斬], upgrade Kōzan [光斬] based on the current Suit in use.

Pine Crane Suit: Kōzan [光斬] gains Advantadge on the attack roll.

Suzuki Grass Suit: On Kōzan [光斬] Hit, Trigger `Amplitude Conversion::Amplitude Conversion` of `Tremor::Tremor` to `Tremor - Decay::Tremor - Decay` on the target, then Trigger `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` on the target.

Blue Sakura Suit: On Kōzan [光斬] Hit, Trigger `Sinking Deluge::Sinking Deluge` on the target.

Talents.name: Flip the Table
Talents.desc:
At 13th level, when discarding a Suit, gain the following benefits.

Pine Crane Suit: On Discard, Give 2 DMG Up to self and the 2 closest allies.

Suzuki Grass Suit: On Discard, Give 5 Temporary Hitpoints to self and the 2 closest allies.

Blue Sakura Suit: On Discard, Give 2 `Protection::Protection` to self and the 2 closest allies.

Talents.name: Betting Suits
Talents.desc:
At 17th level, after choosing a Suit for the turn, you may spend 1 light to Bet the Suit.

Roll 1d6 1–2 (Bust): Your Bet Suit becomes a Lost Suit until the start of your next turn. 3–4 (Neutral): No change. 5–6 (Jackpot): Your Bet Suit becomes a Jackpot Suit until the start of your next turn.

A Lost suit has the Suit Modifiers and Kōzan [光斬] Damage halved.

Pine Crane Suit (Lost): On Hit, Gain 1 `Haste::Haste` at the start of your next turn (Twice per Turn).

Suzuki Grass Suit (Lost): On Hit, Inflict 2 `Tremor::Tremor` and 1 `Bind::Bind` to the target.

Blue Sakura Suit (Lost): On Hit, Inflict 1 `Sinking::Sinking`.

A Jackpot Suit has the Suit Modifiers and Kōzan [光斬] Damage doubled.

Pine Crane Suit: On Hit, Gain 2 Attack Power Up, 2 DMG UP and 4 Haste at the start of your next turn (Twice per Turn).

Suzuki Grass Suit: On Hit, Inflict 8 Tremor and 4 Bind to the target.

Blue Sakura Suit: On Hit, Inflict 4 Sinking and gain 2 Bright [光] (Max 2 Bright [光] per turn)

Talents.name: Stay Calm
Talents.desc: At 1st level, patience is a virtue that you have all but begun to realize. All attacks you land will inflict 2 `Tremor::Tremor`. You may use your bonus action to inflict 2 Tremor on yourself. For every 3 Tremor on self, inflict +1 Tremor on a successful melee attack.

Talents.name: Gamble
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, as an action you may make a single powerful swing with your weapon. Make a Melee weapon attack against a creature within reach. On hit deal weapon damage and spend any increment of 2 `Tremor::Tremor` on self. For every increment you spent, roll a 1d6. On a result of 4 or higher, roll damage an additional time and `Burst Tremor::Tremor Burst`. At 5th level when you spend Tremor on this feature, you may reroll one of your failed d6 rolls. At 11th level, you may reroll twice.

Talents.name: Cleaning Up the Mess
Talents.desc: At 6th level, knocking people off balance is only half the battle, and sometimes they don’t go down easy. After you inflict a creature with `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` and the result of the save is final, inflict 1 `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down`.

Talents.name: Slice
Talents.desc: At 10th level, while your expertise has been opening up the opponents for your allies, you have been able to set yourself up for success. After you inflict `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` and the target fails that save, you may make a single weapon attack. On hit, inflict 4 `Tremor::Tremor` on the target or yourself.

Talents.name: Daring Decision
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you're not just knocking people off balance anymore, you're slamming all your weight into these strikes. When a target fails a `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` save that you inflicted, they take additional damage equal to 30% of the `Tremor::Tremor` the target had before the burst.

Talents.name: Grinding the Molars
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you’ve perfected the techniques that Molar Office has taught you. When using your Gamble feature and you expended 10 `Tremor::Tremor` on yourself, your Gamble turns into Grinding the Molars. Your initial attack roll inflicts the target with 2 `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down` before you roll d6s. You may additionally roll 2 additional d6s on top of your original number.

Talents.name: Stealth Soldier
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you’ve been trained in the art of a quick kill to do your job. You gain proficiency in stealth if you weren’t already proficient while gaining expertise if you were proficient prior. Additionally, your walking speed increases by 10ft. You may take the hide and disengage actions as a bonus action.

Talents.name: Sneak Attack
Talents.desc: At 1st level, once per turn, you can deal an extra Xd6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll, or if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't incapacitated, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll. X is equal to half of your level rounded up. These dice cannot be affected by `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`.

Talents.name: Endless Battle
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you feel most alive when you're closest to death. When at 50% of your maximum hit points or lower, you gain a +1 to all attack and damage rolls. This benefit increases to +2 at 7th level, +3 at 13th level, and +4 at 17th.

Talents.name: Umbral Shadow
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, you gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision from your race, its range increases by 30 feet.

You are also adept at evading creatures that rely on darkvision. While in darkness, you are invisible to any creature that relies on darkvision to see you in that darkness.

Talents.name: Flying Sword
Talents.desc: At 6th level, with a swift kill comes swift speed. Upon reducing a creature to 0 hit points, you may take the dash action for no action cost. Additionally, hitting a creature with your Sneak Attack gives you 3 `Haste::Haste`.

Talents.name: Extreme Edge
Talents.desc: At 6th level, when below 50% of your maximum hit points or lower, gain 1 `Poise::Poise` at the start of your turn. Additionally, when attacking a creature that has not taken a turn in initiative yet, you gain advantage on the attack roll.

Talents.name: To Overcome Crisis
Talents.desc: At 10th level, you understand that in death, everyone is equal, and so is the burden that death brings. When below 50% of your maximum hit points or less, you gain an additional bonus action that may only be used for the disengage, hide and dash actions. Additionally, when falling to 0 hit points, you instead fall to 1 once per long rest.

Talents.name: Flashing Strike
Talents.desc: At 10th level, you may blink in and out of hiding to make a devastating slash. As an action while hiding, you may dash forward up to your movement speed in a straight line, forcing all creatures within 10ft of you during your movement to make a dexterity saving throw with disadvantage or take your weapon damage and sneak attack damage. You have advantage on stealth checks until the start of your next turn after using this feature. After using this feature, you must wait 10 minutes before using it again. Alternatively, you may expend 3 `Light::Light` to use it without waiting out the cooldown.

Talents.name: Desperate Struggle
Talents.desc: At 13th level, the quicker you do the job the less of a mess it leaves, even if it means pushing yourself too hard. As a bonus action on your turn, you may gain 2 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` and 2 `Haste::Haste` in exchange for taking 1d10+10 necrotic damage that cannot be altered or reduced in any way. Using this ability for 3 turns in a row will give you a level of exhaustion. While you have the buffs from this feature, you treat exhaustion as if it was two levels lower, and gain Haste equal to twice the levels of exhaustion you have and Offense Level Up and `Protection::Protection` equal to the exhaustion levels you have. You may have a maximum of 10 Offense Level Up, 10 Protection and 25 Haste. When at 8 or more Offense Level Up from this feature and under 25% of your maximum hit points, your sneak attack dice become d10s.

Talents.name: Boundary of Death
Talents.desc: At 17th level, perfection is something that is earned on a gamble, leading to a quick and clean kill. When landing a critical hit, you may roll the attack roll again, keeping any poise and advantage you may have had. On another critical hit, double your damage dice rolled again. You may only deal the extra damage with this ability once per turn. Once per long rest, while under 25% HP and under the effects of Desperate Struggle, you may also roll 1d4 while using this ability. On a roll of a 4, double the damage dice rolled again.

Talents.name: Smoke Producing Augment
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you will gain an augmentation that can produce `Smoke::Smoke` to use in combat. Upon hitting an attack, gain 2 Smoke, If you are at 10+ Smoke, you may spend 3 Smoke to inflict 2 + Proficiency Bonus `Burn::Burn` onto the target instead. Additionally, you will gain the Puffy Brume Feat.

Talents.name: Smoke Blow
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, upon hitting a creature that has `Burn::Burn`, you may inflict 4 `Charred Smoke::Charred Smoke`. You cannot inflict Charred `Smoke::Smoke` onto a creature who already has Charred Smoke.

Talents.name: Madness
Talents.desc:
At 6th level, The smoke has begun to infest your head, making you go mad. At the start of your turn, roll a 1d8 and gain an effect according to the table below.
**Leaflet Madness Table**

| d8 | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 | Gain 2 Attack Power Up |
| 2 | Gain 2 `Damage Up::Damage Roll Up` |
| 3 | Gain 2 `Haste::Haste` |
| 4 | Gain +2 `Smoke::Smoke` and Inflict +2 `Burn::Burn` this turn with features and skill effects |
| 5 | Gain 5 Smoke, Gain 1 Attack Power Down |
| 6 | Gain 5 Smoke, Gain 1 `Offensive Level Down::Offense Level Down` |
| 7 | Gain 5 Smoke, Gain 2 `Fragile::Fragile` |
| 8 | Gain 5 Smoke, Gain 4 `Bind::Bind` |

At 12th level, you may add or subtract 1 from the d8 roll, and at 18th level, you may reroll the result once.

Talents.name: Immediate Repairs
Talents.desc: At 10th level, you begin to let the smoke repair yourself when you have sustained damage. When below 40% HP, you may consume up to 50 `Smoke::Smoke` on self to heal 1% HP Per Smoke Consumed. This feature can be used once per long rest.

Talents.name: Field Mods
Talents.desc: At 13th level, While at 25+ `Smoke::Smoke`, and `Light::Light` features cost 1 less, to a minimum of 0. Additionally, if you ever end the turn at Maximum Smoke, you will gain 1 `Smoke - Overflowing::Smoke - Overflowing`.

Talents.name: Exhale Smoke
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you may make all creatures within a 45 feet long, 15 feet wide cone make a DC Constitution Saving Throw against your Fixer DC. On a failure, the creatures will take 3d12 psychic damage + 3d12 fire damage, be inflicted with (`Burn::Burn` on Creature / 10) `Smoke::Smoke`, and you gain 1 `Smoke - Overflowing::Smoke - Overflowing` for every creature who failed. On a success, they will take half of the damage, gain half of the burn and you do not gain 1 Smoke - Overflowing.

Talents.name: As My Master Commands
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you’ve been recruited as a butler or maid. You gain proficiency in improvised weapons dealing a 1d6+Strength or Dexterity modifier for all damage with them. However you are particularly skilled with household tools such as brooms, kitchen knives, vacuums, or any other tool you can think of. With these household tools you deal 1d8+Strength or Dexterity damage with a damage type that makes most sense for that object (piercing or slashing for sharp objects, bludgeoning for a vacuum, ect.). Additionally it takes half the time to maintain anything relating to a household such as sweeping, dusting, or washing dishes. All improvised weapons have a throw distance of 45ft. Finally, you gain proficiency in acrobatics or expertise if you are already proficient and gain advantage on saving throws that would charm, frighten, or control you in any way, unless those saving throws or commands come from your master/boss.

Talents.name: Depressive Strike
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you have imbued the power of all the stress you’ve taken on during this job into your strikes. When landing an attack roll, the target must make a Charisma saving throw or take an additional 1d4 psychic damage and suffer a -1d4 on their next attack roll, skill check, or saving throw. Alternatively, if the target imposes a saving throw instead of an attack roll while under the effects of Depressive Strike, their DC is decreased by -1d4. On successful save, Depressive Strike has no effect. Depressive Strike can be used once every round. In the event of the target failing multiple depressive strike saves, they will suffer the -1d4 for every save they failed (EX: the target failed the Depressive Strike saving throw twice and is going to make three attacks on their turn. They will suffer a -1d4 on the first two attack rolls, but not the third). At 10th level you may use this feature twice per round. At 17th level you may use it three times.

Talents.name: Spread of Silverware
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you have grown accustomed to throwing your silverware to the tables you set, and thus throwing them at targets is all the same. As an action on your turn, all creatures within a 20ft cone must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 4d8 piercing damage and are all treated as if they failed the saving throw for Depressive Strike. On successful save targets take half damage and must make a save against Depressive Strike separately. You may use Spread of Silverware a number of times equal to half of your proficiency bonus rounded up. At 13th level damage increases to 6d8.

Talents.name: Echoes of the Manor
Talents.desc: At 10th level, the time you’ve spent as a Butler/Maid has left you with a sensation that will never leave you. After successfully landing an attack against a creature who has already failed the saving throw for Depressive Strike, automatically grant them an additional penalty to Depressive Strike and increase the penalty dice by one tier. Additionally while under the effects of Echoes of the Manor, when the creature makes a check with their penalty, they take psychic damage equal to the size of the penalty dice.

Talents.name: Mental Beatdown
Talents.desc: At 13th level, your strikes hurt the mind and the body more brutally. All weapon attacks deal an additional dice of damage as psychic damage.

Talents.name: Resounding Echoes of the Manor
Talents.desc: At 17th level, the echoes become more violent, sounding as you strike targets. When you use your Echoes of the Manor feature, cause all hostile creatures within 30ft of the target to make the same saving throw. Additionally, all dice of Depressive Strike and Echoes of the Manor increase by one tier. Finally deal an additional dice of psychic damage equal to your weapon dice when attacking. A target under the effects of Depressive Strike or Echoes of the Manor.

Talents.name: Blight of the Manor
Talents.desc: At 1st level, your mere existence is a raging tempest, and an omen to those who have wronged you. You have become a leader of the wild hunt. You learn the vicious mockery cantrip that you may cast, using your `Light::Light` modifier to calculate the saving throw. Additionally, after making an attack with a two handed weapon, you may use vicious mockery as a bonus action. You may do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. Additionally, Death Fuels your every action and every step you take. For every target defeated in a combat encounter by you, gain 1 Coffin. For every Coffin, deal an additional 1d8 necrotic damage per hit. You may have a maximum number of Coffin stacks equal to half of your proficiency bonus rounded up. Finally, you gain the Great Weapon Master feat. When you cast vicious mockery, you may choose not deal any damage in order to inflict sinking equal to the would-be psychic damage.

Talents.name: Wild Hunt
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you have discovered latent abilities within yourself, ones that allow you to raise the dead only after they have recently passed. As a reaction to an allied creature being reduced to 0 hit points, you may turn them into a wild hunt version of themselves for one round and restore 25% of their max hit points. While a creature is a wild hunt, they are considered to be under the dominant person/monster (respective to their creature type) spell until the end of their next turn. On that creature's next turn they may take it as usual, however at the end of the round the wild hunted ally is then downed immediately. You may use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

Talents.name: O Dullahan…!
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you have gained access to a headless horse named Dullahan that you may summon at will. You may call this horse forth as a bonus action, or instead of attacking after a `Clash::Clashing` - Counter. While mounted, you have a walking speed of 60ft and may dash as a bonus action. Additionally, while mounted, you have an `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` and a `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down`. You may summon and dismiss Dullahan as a bonus action. Finally, you gain the Charger feat. While mounted, you may also use this feat by dashing as a bonus action.

Talents.name: Funeral Processions
Talents.desc: At 10th level, you are able to conjure wild hunt versions of yourself to charge at an area. Target all creatures within a 30ft cone or 15ft radius. All creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw or take your weapon damage on failure and fall prone, or half as much damage and not falling prone on success. You may use Funeral Processions a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. The area of this feature increases to a 45ft cone or 20ft radius at 13th level, and a 60ft cone and 30ft radius at 17th level.

Talents.name: Beheading
Talents.desc: At 13th level, your raw strength makes every hit hurt more. When wielding a strength-based weapon, increase its damage dice tier by 1 (Ex: 2d6->2d8, 1d12->2d6). Additionally, when landing a critical hit with a strength-based weapon, deal triple damage instead of double.

Talents.name: Requiem
Talents.desc: At 17th level, your pent up rage has reached its climax, just waiting to be unleashed like a raging tempest. Target one creature within 5ft and impose a Strength saving throw. On failure, make an attack that will automatically critically hit and add 5d12 lightning damage as you grab the target before slamming your weapon into them. On Successful save the target only takes the lightning damage. After using this attack, you may make a recharge roll at the beginning of each of your turns, rolling a 1d20, successfully recharging on a 19-20.

Talents.name: Bloodied Weapons
Talents.desc:
At 1st Level you gain the ability to create a weapon made of hardened blood as a bonus action on your turn. When doing so, you gain 6 `Bleed::Bleed` stacks to extract the blood from yourself and create a simple or martial melee weapon that you are proficient with that deals its damage and inflict 2 Bleed stacks on hit. You may enhance a weapon you already possess however, causing it to simply inflict 2 Bleed stacks. You may create a number of these weapons equal to your proficiency bonus and may cause any of them to un-enhance an enhanced weapon or cause a created weapon to be dissolved into a pool of blood as a free action.

Additionally, you can no longer be reduced to 0 hit points because of bleed damage.

Talents.name: Bloodfeast
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level you’ve indulged more heavily in your hunger for blood, and it grants you power as it stains the ground. All `bleed::Bleed` damage dealt is stored and accounted for as Bloodfeast. Bloodfeast is used to fuel other features, however, grants passive benefits to you for retaining. Once per turn at the beginning of the turn you may absorb an amount of blood from the Bloodfeast up to a maximum of 10. Upon consuming Bloodfeast, you may then as a free action spend 10 consumed Bloodfeast to gain one of the following benefits.

* +10ft movement speed
* +1 AC
* +1 to attack and damage rolls

Additionally, upon consuming Bloodfeast equal to your maximum, your `Bloodied Weapons::Bloodied Weapons` Bleed stacks that it inflicts on creatures is doubled (2 -> 4). Bloodfeast is reset at the beginning of a long rest

Talents.name: Be Impaled
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you may control the blood seeped into the ground to impale your targets. You may spend 25, unconsumed `Bloodfeast::Bloodfeast` to target all creatures in a 20ft area within 30ft of you, or in a 15ft radius of you. All hostile creatures in the area must then make a dexterity saving throw or take 4d8 piercing damage and be inflicted with 6 `Bleed::Bleed` stacks.

Talents.name: Siphon
Talents.desc: At 10th level, when consuming at least 5 `Bloodfeast::Bloodfeast` at the beginning of your turn, regain 1d6 hit points. If you consume 10 Bloodfeast or more, then recover 1d6+Constitution modifier hit points instead.

Talents.name: Improved Blood Creation
Talents.desc: At 13th level, with your continued experience, you’ve been able to fine tune your blood creations. Your `Bloodied Weapons::Bloodied Weapons` inflict +1 `bleed::Bleed` for every time you consume the maximum amount of `Bloodfeast::Bloodfeast` on your turn to a maximum of +2. Additionally, when using your `Be Impaled::Be Impaled` feature, you now cause all creatures who fail the saving throw to be restrained. Creatures who are restrained in this way may remake the save at the end of their turns to free themselves, taking 1d4 bleeding (necrotic) damage on failed save. Alternatively, a creature may attack the spike they are impaled on to try and destroy it. The spike has an AC of 10 and 10 hit points. Once the spike is destroyed, the target is no longer restrained.

Talents.name: Higher Kindred
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you’ve established yourself well within your family and with that gained the benefits. You gain the `Hardblood Arts::Hardblood Arts` feature from the fixer feats list. If you already have it, then you may take the Ascended Hardblood Arts feature instead. Additionally, you may now further your bloodline by creating up to two Kindred of your own. Do note that whatever ranked kindred you are will cause your own Kindred to be ranked one below you. For example, if you are a third kindred, your kindred will be fourth kindred and so on. In order to turn somebody into a kindred, they must be a willing dying humanoid, or a recently deceased humanoid. The process of turning a creature into kindred takes up to an hour being having to give some of your own blood to the creature, and then waiting to see if their body accepts the blood. The creature you are attempting to turn must make a DC = 8 Constitution saving throw. On success they will return to life. Their new race will be blood fiend and they may choose to take the fixer class and bloodfiend affiliation if they would like. On failure the body will dissolve and coagulate the blood, turning them into a puddle of blood. Your kindred will listen to you if you command them to do something, however they still hold their own opinions and if given permission to speak freely, will. Otherwise they follow the same rules the bloodfiend race follows, treating you and all kindred above you as their parents/grandparents.

Talents.name: Inhale Smoke
Talents.desc: At 1st level, as a bonus action, you may gain 2 `Smoke::Smoke`. This increases to 3 smoke at 10th level and to 4 smoke at 17th level.

Talents.name: Puffy Brume
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you’re granted a respirator that allows you to channel smoke. While under the effects of `Smoke::Smoke`, instead of damage of an increased dice tier, increase your own damage by one dice tier. This feature may stack up to a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

Talents.name: Smoking Pipe
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, as a bonus action, you may consume 3 `Smoke::Smoke` to gain 1 `Light::Light`. This feature may be used a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Talents.name: Flesh Fillet
Talents.desc: At 6th level, once per turn, you may consume any amount of `smoke::Smoke` on self. By doing so, you may inflict bleed on hit equal to (Smoke consumed / 3).

Talents.name: Stimulating Fumes
Talents.desc: At 10th level, whenever you use a reaction to clash with an incoming attack with two or more `Smoke::Smoke` on self, you may add a 1d4 to the clash roll. For every 2 Smoke above 2 (ex. Any multiples of 2), increase the dice’s tier by 1. Additionally, you may consume any amount of Smoke on self in order to gain the same benefit on any dice roll, so long as you’re conscious.

Talents.name: Smoke Addiction
Talents.desc: At 13th level, when landing an attack against a target that has 8 or more `Smoke::Smoke`, you may additionally inflict 2 `Paralysis::Paralysis`. This feature may only activate once per turn.

Talents.name: Sooty Thwack
Talents.desc: At 17th level, when making an attack roll against a target with smoke, the target’s AC is considered to be reduced by (`Smoke::Smoke` on self / 2).

Talents.name: Twisted Chains
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you have learned ways to use chains in combat. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + STR bludgeoning damage and have 10 ft reach. When attacking from more than 5 ft away, you cannot benefit from passive effects of Cestus/Glove items. On hit with an unarmed strike or chain attack, you inflict `Bleed::Bleed` equal to your proficiency bonus and gain Bleed on yourself equal to twice your proficiency bonus. You may use your chains to make Grapple checks at 10 ft of range, if your grapple succeeds, they will be pulled towards you. Additionally, you take halved damage to bleed and cannot be reduced below 1 HP from taking Bleed Damage unless another creature has inflicted Bleed onto you.

Your unarmed strike damage dice increases to 1d8 at 5th level, 1d10 at 10th level, and finally 1d12 at 15th level.

Talents.name: Bloodrush
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you begin to enjoy the pain and use it to continue fighting. At the beginning of your turn, gain (`Bleed::Bleed` / 5, Max Proficiency Bonus, Rounded Down) `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` and `Protection::Protection`.

Talents.name: Sublimate
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you have found more ways to turn this pain into power. Once per turn, you may choose not to lower your `bleed::Bleed` stack when taking an attack action, when doing so, that attack will gain a +(Proficiency Bonus - 1) to the Attack Roll and Damage Roll and you will take half of the Bleed damage.

Talents.name: Open Wound
Talents.desc: At 10th level, when hitting an enemy that has less `Bleed::Bleed` than yourself, you will consume up to 20 Bleed on self and you can force the target to make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Fixer DC. On a failure, you may consume up to 20 Bleed on self to inflict onto the target, you will take 1 Necrotic damage for every Bleed consumed this way. On a success, you will take the consumed Bleed as necrotic damage, and they will not be inflicted with it. If the target is grappled by you, they will make the saving throw with disadvantage.

Talents.name: Now Die
Talents.desc: At 13th level, if a creatures hit point value is equal or lower than (`Bleed::Bleed` on creature * 2), then you will score guaranteed critical hits against creatures and inflict doubled bleed.

Talents.name: Bloodthirsty
Talents.desc: At 17th Level, when you would have died to an attack, Once per Long Rest, reduce all incoming damage to 0 until the beginning of your next turn, then gain 1 HP and (`Bleed::Bleed` On Self * 5) Temporary Hit Points, 2 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`, and 2 `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down`. You cannot be healed until you have run out of temporary hit points. You cannot gain temporary hit points from outside features while this effect is active. Once you run out of Temporary Hit Points, set Hit Points to 0 and begin making death saving throws as if you have been knocked.

Talents.name: Force of the Arbiter
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you’ve been trained to be a killing machine, who values no life until told to. Your training was cruel in the eyes of others, but to you it was necessary to get where you are today. While not wearing armor your AC is equal to 10+Dexterity+Wisdom. All saving throws or fixer attack rolls are made with your Wisdom modifier in place of Strength or Dexterity. Additionally, by using your action you may attack at a range of 60ft dealing 1d10 damage on hit. This damage cannot be negated or resisted in any way. The damage of this attack increases to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th, and 4d10 at 17th level.

Talents.name: Degraded Fairy
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your energy lingers after attacking a target, causing them to feel pain upon doing anything. When landing an attack roll with your Force of the Arbiter attack, you may choose to inflict `Fairy::Fairy` on them. Upon doing so they give off a faint light and the target takes 1d4 damage for taking any actions (actions, bonus actions, reactions, free actions, legendary actions, or movement). This damage is taken upon the target using an action. This damage increases to 1d6 at 11th level.

Talents.name: Degraded Pillar
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you’ve gained the ability to manifest certain objects with your power. As an action, you may fire off a pillar of black and gold energy. Make a ranged attack roll against a target within 30ft. On hit they must make a Constitution saving throw. On failure the target is knocked back 10ft and is stunned until the end of their next turn.

Talents.name: Degraded Chain
Talents.desc: At 10th level, you may chain a target to the ground with black and gold chains. As an action you may target a creature within 50ft and force them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On failure they take 5d8 damage and are restrained until the end of their next turn.

Talents.name: Degraded Lock
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you can entirely shut down an opponent's motor functions by locking them down entirely. Choose a creature that you can see within 60ft. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of their next turn. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

Talents.name: Degraded Shockwave
Talents.desc: At 17th level, your hand alone can take down an army. As an action you may cause all hostile creatures within 120ft to make three Dexterity saving throws. On every failure the creature takes 5d10 damage and half on successful save. Additionally, all allies gain your Wisdom modifier in AC and to saving throws and hostiles suffer the opposite using your Wisdom modifier as a detriment until the beginning of your next turn. You may use this feature once per long rest.

Talents.name: Carapace
Talents.desc: At 1st level, Through unknown means you’ve been taken in to become a Claw. Your group is both respected and feared. You have begun to grow a brown carapace over one of your arm creating a claw granting you +1 AC. This claw deals 1d8 slashing. You gain proficiency in this claw and gain unarmed strike proficiency dealing the same damage as your claw. Finally, as a bonus action you may make a single unarmed strike as a bonus action. If this bonus action attack was used after an attack action where at least one attack hit, this bonus action attack automatically hits.

Talents.name: Serums
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, your claw arm has three needles embedded in it all with various effects to help you in battle. You have a number of serum uses equal to Proficiency Bonus + Constitution modifier.

* Serum-R: You may expend 1 serum use to add +1d8 to any strength check or save you make. Additionally, when making a clash roll, you may expend 2 serum uses to gain a +1d8 to the clash roll.
* Serum-K: As a bonus action you may use the serum and recover 1d12+Constitution modifier. Alternatively, you may choose to heal no hit points to instead recover a missing limb.
* Serum-W: As an action you may teleport to a target within 120ft and make an unarmed strike against them. On hit you grab them and slam them through a dimension dealing 2d10+STR modifier magical bludgeoning damage. You may expend additional serum usage to deal an additional 2d10 damage by slamming them through another dimension. Every additional serum usage counts as a different attack for the sake of calculating damage.

You may only use one serum per round. You recover all serum uses upon completing a long rest.

Talents.name: Extirpation
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you may crouch to the ground before dashing towards your target and attacking them at mach speed. Choose a point within 30ft and move along that line. All hostile creatures caught within that line must make a dexterity saving throw or take 5d10+STR slashing damage on failure or half as much on success. You may use Extirpation once per long rest. Additionally, you may spend 3 serum charges to regain a use of this feature.

Talents.name: Improved Carapace
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your carapace has expanded covering more of your body, protecting you and making you stronger. You gain +2 to your AC and attack and damage rolls with your claws. The claws count as magical for the sake of overcoming resistances, treating immunity as if it were resistance and now deal 1d10 damage instead of 1d8. Additionally you gain resistance to non-magical slashing damage.

Talents.name: Improved Serums
Talents.desc:
At 13th level, you’ve developed a means to get the most from your serums. They improve in the following ways:

* Serum-R: you may expend 1 serum use to add +1d8+Srength Modifier to any strength check or save you make. Additionally, when making a clash roll, you may expend 2 serum uses to gain a +1d8+Srength Modifier to the clash roll.
* Serum-K: As a bonus action you may use the serum and recover 2d12+Constitution modifier. Alternatively, you may choose to heal no hit points to instead recover a missing limb. Additionally, as a reaction to falling to 0 hit points, you may use 3 serum charges to instead return to 1 hit point and gain the benefits of Serum-K.
* Serum-W: As an action you may teleport to a target within 150ft and make an unarmed strike against them. On hit you grab them and slam them through a dimension dealing 3d10+STR modifier magical bludgeoning damage. You may expend additional serum usage to deal additional 3d10 damage by slamming them through another dimension. Every additional serum usage counts as a different attack for the sake of calculating damage.

Finally, you gain an additional 2 serum uses per long rest (2+Proficiency Bonus+Constitution Modifier=Number of Serum Uses).

Talents.name: Tri-Serum Cocktail
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you’ve gotten the most of all of your serums that combining them no longer seems like too bad of an idea. For 5 serum charges you may use this feature. Gain the benefits of Serum-R and Serum-K on use. Then target up to 6 creatures of your choice within 150ft of you. After targeting them you may teleport anywhere within 15ft of them making 1 Extirpation attack against all of them. This Extirpation attack may hit any other creatures within the line that you may come into contact with so long as the unit you are targeting with that specific attack was a target of the attack. Repeat this for every target of Tri-Serum Cocktail. You may use this feature once per long rest.

Talents.name: Gene Codes
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, your body gains mutations to appear more bug-like, helping you in combat. You may choose one of the following Mutations. You cannot change this mutation later.

---

Maggot:

Gain 10 Maggot Charges, Upon hitting an unarmed strike, you may spend 1 Maggot `Charge::Charge` to inflict 1 Maggots onto the creature. Upon hitting a Bite attack, you may spend up to 2 Maggot Charges to inflict up to 2 Maggots. Maggot Charges count as the Maggots Status Effect. If a creature with Maggots dies, you may regain the Maggots they had as Maggot Charges. You may regain 2 Maggot Charges as a bonus action.

**Maggots: Max Stack: 10**

At the end of your turn, make a constitution saving throw against the inflictors Fixer DC + (X / 2). On a failure, take X Gluttony Necrotic Damage then gain (X / 2) `Bleed::Bleed`. On a success, take half as much damage, do not gain Bleed, and reduce the stack by 1. If this character has the Maggot Gene Code, instead gain (X / 2) Temporary Hit Points.

---

Moth: At the start of your turn, creatures of your choice within 15ft of this creature must make constitution saving throw against your Fixer DC, on a failure, they are inflicted with 3 `Poison::Poison`. Your Bite Attacks inflict 5 Poison on hit. Additionally, you will have the ability to hover in the air for up to 1 minute at a time, and gain resistance to Poison Damage.

---

Fly: You gain expertise in Perception. You gain 120ft of darkvision. Your speed increases by 10ft. You gain a flight and climb speed equal to your walk speed. However if you end your turn while in the air, you will fall down to the ground. Additionally, once per combat, you may make an additional reaction past your maximum. You have a +10 to your passive perception, as your eyes can see in all directions.

---

Cockroach: Gain a cockroach arm that deals 1d8+DEX piercing damage and inflict 2 `Rupture::Rupture` on hit, the arms count as unarmed strikes. At the start of your turn, regenerate Proficiency Bonus HP. Gain an Armor Class while not wearing armor of 13 + DEX. However you can no longer wield two-handed weapons.

---

Additionally, you will gain a Bite attack, it counts as an unarmed strike, but can only be used once per turn. The Bite Attack deals 1d4+DEX, and gains a dice tier increase by the DEX Mod. +3 Dex would make it deal 1d10+DEX. On Hit with the Bite attack, Inflict 2 Bleed.

Talents.name: Survival
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your insect body becomes more resilient. You may choose a damage type to become resistant after completing a long rest. This cannot change until you complete another Long Rest. If you are already resistant to that damage type, you can reduce the incoming damage further by your proficiency bonus.

Talents.name: Furthered Mutation
Talents.desc:
At 6th level, your Gene Code becomes enhanced.

---

**Maggot - Rotting Wounds**

When a hostile creature has your Maggots, they will lose (X / 5, Rounded Down) AC, gain 1 `Bind::Bind` at the start of their turn, and any healing they receive will be reduced by X.
