Increase maggot charges to 15, and increase the maximum stack of maggots to 15. You now regain 3 Maggots with a bonus action instead. You may also inflict up to 3 Maggots on a bite.

---

**Moth - Infesting Scales**

As an action on your turn, you may send a gust of wind carrying your infesting scales in a 10ft wide, 90ft long cylinder in front of you. All creatures in this area must make a CON Saving throw against your Fixer DC. On a failure, they will gain 8 `Poison::Poison` and become Charmed. While charmed, they will move towards you and protect you as best as they can. The Charm lasts for one minute. You can use this feature an amount of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Charmed creatures can retry the saving throw at the start of their turn. A charmed creature is not obligated to attack its allies. Every charmed creature within 15ft of you gives you 1 `Protection::Protection`, up to 5 maximum. A creature that succeeds this save is immune to the effect for the next 24 hours, instead taking an extra 4 Poison from a failed save. At the start of your turn, creatures charmed by you gain 3 Poison.

---

**Fly - Digestive Acid**

You will gain a new attack where you spit digestive acid at a creature, which scales off of Dexterity, and you will be proficient with the attack. This attack deals 2d8+DEX acid damage. You may only use this attack once per turn. On hit, inflict 6 `Tremor::Tremor` and if the target has 20+ Tremor, trigger `Amplitude Conversion::Amplitude Conversion` into Tremor - Rot.

Tremor - Rot: At the start of your turn, take (X / 4) acid damage, then reduce tremor by (X / 10). When a `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` is triggered, take X acid damage. Then, halve tremor.

---

Cockroach - Regenerative Capabilities When being reduced to 0 HP, restore to 25% Max HP (Once per Long Rest). You will gain advantage on death saving throws. If you succeed on all of your death saving throws, you will regenerate to 1 HP instead of being stabilised normally.

---

Talents.name: Kill or be Killed
Talents.desc: At 10th level, you gain immunity to being diseased, and gain resistance to `poison::Poison` damage and immunity to the poisoned condition. You can sense creatures within 120 feet of you that are below 25% Max HP, and you gain 10ft of Tremorsense and 120ft of darkvision, or 1000ft of darkvision if you have the Fly gene code.

Talents.name: Consumption
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, Upon killing a creature, you may eat its corpse to regenerate (CR * X)% HP. It takes less than a minute to consume a Small Creature or Smaller, 5 Minutes to consume a medium creature, 30 minutes to consume a large, and huge creature will take an hour. You cannot consume things bigger than huge. The multiplier of the formula is determined by the following:

* Small Creatures or Smaller - 1x
* Medium Creatures - 1.5x
* Large Creatures - 2x
* Huge Creatures - 3x

The time it takes to eat a corpse is up to DM discretion. The times here simply serve as a guideline.

Additionally, when you kill or knock out a creature, you may tear through its body to quickly regenerate some health. As a bonus action after killing or knocking out a creature, you may make 3 attacks against them, healing 2d12 hit points per attack landed. These hit automatically if the creature dies.

Talents.name: Pupal Ecdysis
Talents.desc:
At 13th level, you feel your body tensing and readying for your upcoming eclosion.

---

**Maggot - Writhing Larvae**

Your maximum stack of maggots and your maximum maggot charges both increase to 20. When hitting a creature, you may cause all maggots inside them to explode, removing all their maggots and making them take X Gluttony Necrotic damage and X `Bleed::Bleed`, along with triggering their bleed once without reducing it. They then gain 2 `Bind::Bind` and 2 `Paralysis::Paralysis`, and become immune to maggots until the start of your next turn. You may also inflict 4 Maggots on a bite, and 2 Maggots on an unarmed strike.

---

**Moth - Burrowing Parasites**

Creatures with 45 or more `Poison::Poison` gain 2 Bind and 1 Paralysis at the start of their turn. You may choose to toggle these effects, and this only affects creatures you have poisoned.

---

**Fly - Flickering Takeoff**

As a reaction to taking damage, you may reduce the damage by an amount equal to your level + your dexterity modifier. If this reduces the damage to 0, it counts as having missed you, and you may fly up to half of your movement speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If you do not reduce the damage to 0, take full damage and inflict 3 `Tremor::Tremor` on your attacker if they are within 10ft of you. You gain an additional reaction for this feature.

---

**Cockroach - Stubborn Persistence**

You gain a +5 to death saving throws. While making death saving throws, you may still move up to half of your speed. When you would regenerate to 1 Hit Point from succeeding death saves, instead regenerate to 10% of your maximum hit points. Your AC is increased by 5 while making death saving throws, and creatures do not gain benefits against you for being unconscious. You may choose to make an additional death saving throw on your turn, foregoing all bonuses or advantage to it.

---

Talents.name: Wing's Decisive Weapon
Talents.desc:
At 17th level, you complete your metamorphosis into your true form. You may activate this form for 10 minutes with no action cost, at any point. You can enter this form up to 3 times per day.

---

**Maggot - The Maggot Prince**

Increase the maximum stack of Maggots to 50, and your Maggot Charges increases to 100. At the start of your turn, any creatures of your choice within 60ft of you must make a constitution saving throw against your Fixer DC, on a failure, you may spend up to 10 Maggot Charges to inflict X Maggots onto the creature and deal Xd10 necrotic damage. You have 1 `Defense Level Up::Defense Level Up` and 1 `Protection::Protection` for every 20 Maggot Charges you have. You may regain 20 Maggots as a bonus action.

---

**Moth - The Moth Princess**

Increase `Poison::Poison` affliction by 2x. You now gain a fly speed equal to double your movement speed. Your Infesting Scales attack now has 1000ft of range, and now is 80ft wide. When you Charm an enemy, they are now charmed until they succeed the save, with no maximum duration (this remains after the form ends). You may deal up to 50 psychic damage to any creature charmed by you at the start of your turn, and you regain hit points equal a fifth of the damage dealt. When a creature charmed by you dies, creatures within 30ft of it must make a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you.

---

**Fly - Lord of Flies**

Gain 10 Swarm of the Lord of Flies. Upon hitting an attack, you will transfer 1 Swarm of the Lord of Flies to the hit creature. At the start of your turn, generate 2 Swarm of the Lord of Flies. While at 5+ Swarm, you gain a flying (hover) speed equal to half of your movement speed.

**Swarm of the Lord of Flies: Max Stack: 10**

At the start of your turn, take Xd10 necrotic damage at the start of every turn along with gaining (Necrotic Damage Taken / 5) `Tremor::Tremor`. At 10 Stacks, automatically convert Tremor into Tremor - Rot. This character may make a DC (10 + X * 2) Constitution Saving Throw to remove one stack at the start of their turn. While this effect is applied to the Lord of Flies, they will gain (Xd10 / 2) Temporary Hit Points instead of taking necrotic damage.

---

**Cockroach - `The Roach Emperor::The Roach Emperor`**

Gain 100 Protecting Pests [Roaches]. Upon hitting an Attack, make the creature make a CON Saving Throw or else they will be inflicted with 3 Hurting Pests [Roaches], on a success they will gain 1 Hurting Pests [Roaches] instead. At turn start after Protecting Pests [Roaches] activates, regain 5 Protecting Pests [Roaches]. When you would take `Burn::Burn`, `Bleed::Bleed` or `Rupture::Rupture` damage, reduce your Protecting Pests [Roaches] by half of the damage. When you start your turn with Tremor or `Sinking::Sinking`, lose Protecting Pests [Roaches] equal to half of the amount on you. You may lose a maximum of 50 Protecting Pests [Roaches] in a round.

Protecting Pests [Roaches]: Max Stack: 100 Gain (X * 3) Temporary Hit Points and (X / 10, Rounded Up) Armor Class at the start of your turn, these temporary hit points refresh at the start of your turn.

Hurting Pests [Roaches]: Max Stack: 50 At the start of your turn, take X necrotic damage. As an action, you may make a constitution saving throw, removing an amount of roaches equal to your constitution modifier on a success, or half of that on a failure.

---

Any special effect is removed upon exiting the transformation.

Talents.name: Medical Technology
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you’ve landed a job from a big corporation. You’ll be doing security work, but you hope that your skill will raise you through the ranks. You’ve been granted access to K-Corp Ampules. You have a number of ampules equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. These ampules may be injected manually through an injection gun you’ve been supplied on any target within 5ft. These ampules have one of two effects. The first is to recover any limbs in an instant that may have been removed, blown up, disintegrated, it honestly doesn’t matter how. The other is to recover an amount of hit points equal to your proficiency bonus d12. You may administer the ampules as a bonus action; however, you may only administer one ampule per person for healing hit points and once for recovering limbs per long rest. You may use an amount of ampules equal to your proficiency bonus for healing and limb regeneration respectively per long rest.

Talents.name: Impede the Intruder
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your training has had a very heavy emphasis on stopping hostile targets at all costs. You gain the sentinel feat, and Clash-Stall refunds 1 light on a success.

Talents.name: Decay Blade
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your weapons gain a coating similar to that of the Ampules but with a twist. You may expend an ampule use upon hitting a creature in order to deal an amount of necrotic damage to them equal to the healing it would have done.

Talents.name: Experimental Ampules
Talents.desc: At 10th level, you’ve been given experimental ampules, ones more potent than the standard issue, but with some drastic side effects. You may choose to use an experimental dose or a normal dose when using your bonus action. Upon using an experimental dose, you may revive a creature who has died in the last minute. Upon their revival, they take an additional dice of damage from all sources until a long rest. Alternatively, you may inject it into yourself to give yourself a boost. For three turns, you gain a +1 to your attack and damage rolls and an `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`.

Talents.name: Excise Target
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you’ve been promoted to the Excision Team of K-Corp and as such comes training that allows for more effective use of your ampules. For every ampule you’ve injected yourself with per combat, deal an additional dice of damage from all weapon attacks. Additionally, you may swing your weapon violently in a circular motion and as an action make a dashing attack attacking all creatures in a 30ft long line, causing all creatures within 5ft of the line to make a Dexterity saving throw. On failure they take 8d6+Strength modifier slashing damage + additional necrotic damage equal to the amount of ampules you've used. On successful save, they take half damage. You may use this feature a number of times equal to the number of ampules you’ve used per combat. You also gain an additional ampule use total.

Talents.name: Excision Team Captain
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you’ve risen the ranks just as you thought you would you’re now top of you class and as such your body is superhuman. You gain the following benefits. You gain the powerful build feature and your Strength or Dexterity, and constitution scores increase by +2 and so do their maximums. You may now choose to combine your Ampules effects into one usage when using them on yourself as your body has grown accustomed to the repeated usage. You no longer suffer drawbacks from your ampules when they are used on yourself. Finally, your weapons passively deal 5 extra necrotic damage. You also gain an additional ampule use total.

Talents.name: Aggressive Infantry
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you are trained to not hold anything back in your assault. When attacking a target, you gain 2 `Charge::Charge`. Bonus action attacks only give 1 Charge. You gain a number of charge equal to attacks landed, however, charge disappears over time. Decrease your charge count by 1 every round only being able to hold 20 charge at a given time. Additionally, you may choose to gain advantage on all attack rolls for your turn, but all creatures have advantage against you during that time. Additionally, you may expend 2 Charge at the start of your turn to gain an `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`, with each consecutive use costing an additional charge to use.

Talents.name: 4th Pack Path
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, your skills have been proven enough to join one of the three branches within the 4th pack, and upon your joining, they give you a special suit. You gain proficiency with R-Corp suits where creatures otherwise would not be able to use it. Choose one of the paths below, this choice cannot be changed later on. You gain additional features depending on your path at 10th and 17th levels.

**Rabbit**

You’ve undergone extensive surgery and are now as light as a feather and nimble as well. Gain +1 to ac for every 2 `Haste::Haste` you have, to a maximum of +5 AC. For every 30ft you move during a turn gain 1 `charge::Charge`, to a maximum of 4 Charge. On hit inflict 3 `bleed::Bleed`.

You’ve been given a suit that enhances your senses and reactions with powerful stimuli, while wearing the suit you have an AC equal to 13+DEX, While at 6+ charge gain 4 haste at the start of your turn. Once per minute you may spend 10 charge and take an additional action on your turn. You cannot gain charge during this action.

**Reindeer**

You’ve undergone extensive surgery and now proudly own a pair of agonizingly painful antlers. As a free action at the start of your turn you may gain 4 `sinking::Sinking` and gain 4 Charge. Gain a 15ft Mind Suppression aura. At the start of your turn, or when a creature first enters your aura, they gain 3 Sinking, a creature cannot gain sinking twice in the same round from this class feature. On hit inflict 2 Sinking.

You've been given a suit that helps you focus your new damping abilities, while wearing the suit you have an ac=11+DEX+`Light::Light` Mod While at 6+ Charge, enemies within your aura take 1d4 psychic damage at the start of their turn for every 5 sinking on them. You may spend 10 Charge at the start of your turn to increase your aura’s range by 5ft for the next minute.

**Rhino**

You’ve undergone extensive surgery and resemble a tank more than a man Whenever you take damage, gain 1 Charge. Your hit die become d12s and your size becomes large. On a hit, inflict 3 `Tremor::Tremor` or spend 2 charge and `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst`.

You've been given a suit that enhances your physique beyond all human limits, while wearing the suit you have an Ac=15+CON. While at 6+ Charge, whenever you are hit by an enemy they gain 3 Tremor. You may spend 10 charge you may make a weapon attack on hit dealing 2x weapon damage, bursting Tremor and inflicting 3 `Fragile::Fragile` and 1 `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down` on a hit.

Talents.name: Hatchery's Resilience
Talents.desc:
At 6th level, death is no rarity in your life and as such you bounce back quite easily. Once per long rest when reduced to 0 hit points you instead return to 1. While at 1 HP, you count as having 100% of your maximum HP missing for these features.

**Rabbit Augmentation**

At the start of your turn, gain 2 `Haste::Haste` for every 25% of your max hp missing.

**Reindeer Treatment**

At the start of your turn, inflict +1 more sinking with mind suppression for every 25% of your max hp missing, to a maximum of +4.

**Rhino Procedure**

At the start of your turn gain 2 `protection::Protection` for every 25% of your max hp.

Talents.name: Pack Path Improvement
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, your continued support grants you an additional passive and skill of your respective branch. Gain the following ability depending on your 4th Pack Path. Attacks made with these abilities do not gain charge.

* Rabbit

**Graze the Grass**

You may spend 5 `Charge::Charge` as an action, causing all creatures in a 30ft cone to make a dexterity saving throw or take twice your rifle's damage and bleed infliction, or half as much on a success. You may then move a distance up to your movement speed, making up to 2 attacks during this move, with each inflicting an extra 1 `Bleed::Bleed`. You may only use this move once per minute.

**Prowess**

For every 2 levels of `Haste::Haste`, gain a +1 to attack and damage rolls, to a maximum of +3.

* Reindeer

**Mind Whip**

You may spend 5 charge as an action, making an attack against one creature within 30ft of you, dealing 3d10 psychic damage and 7 `sinking::Sinking` against them. This triggers `sinking deluge::Sinking Deluge`, and then reduce sinking by half instead of completely removing it. All hostile creatures adjacent to the target take psychic damage equal to half of the damage to the main target and gain 5 sinking. You may only use this move once per minute.~

**Survivor**

Gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls for every 7 Sinking total within your Mind Suppression radius, to a maximum of +5.

* Rhino

**Bulky Impact**

You may spend 5 charge as an action, moving up to your movement speed and making an attack against a creature. If that attack hits, you may attempt to grapple the creature, and on a successful grapple, deal your weapon damage again to that creature. You may then move up to twice your speed again in a straight line, forcing all creatures you enter the space of during this move to make a dexterity saving throw, taking an amount of damage equal to your weapon damage and being knocked prone on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. You may only use this move once per minute.

**Crash**

If you start your turn with 15 or more charge, gain 3 `Defense Level Up::Defense Level Up` and 1 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up`.

Talents.name: Power in Pain
Talents.desc: At 13th level, low health just means you aren’t trying hard enough. While under half of your maximum hit points, gain a +2 to your attack rolls, ability checks, clash rolls and saving throws. When being reduced to 0 hit points, you may instead return to 25% of your maximum hit points and temporarily change your maximum hit points to 25% of their standard amount. This effect ends after a minute, or after combat ends, whichever happens first, after which you fall to 1 hit point and gain the poisoned condition and halved movement speed for 10 minutes.

Talents.name: 4th Pack Superiority
Talents.desc:
At 17th level, you are at the top of your pack, gaining you a final increase in power.

* Rabbit

**Quick Suppression**

As an action for 5 `Charge::Charge` while holding a melee weapon and firearm, you may use Quick Suppression. Make 2 ranged weapon attacks against a creature within range. After making the attack rolls, instantly move within melee range of that target and make 3 melee weapon attacks against them. If you are at 5 or more charge at the beginning of your turn, each attack deals an additional damage dice per damage roll. You may only use this move once every 10 minutes.

* Reindeer

**Mind Crush**

As an action for 5 Charge, make 5 attacks against a creature within 30ft of you. These attacks inflict an extra 3 `Sinking::Sinking` each. You may use additional charge to power up this attack. For every 2 additional Charge spent, increase the Sinking applied by the last attack by 2, to a maximum of +10 Sinking. You may only use this move once every 10 minutes.

* Rhino

**Fortress**

As an action for 5 Charge, you may gain 20 `Aggro::Aggro`, 2 `Defense Level Up::Defense Level Up` and 5 `Protection::Protection` for the next minute. While you have this Aggro, gain 20 temporary hit points at the start of your turn. This Aggro has a 30ft range and fully depletes after a minute. You may only use this move once every 10 minutes.

Talents.name: T Corp Pocket Watch
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you’ve been hired as a time collections agent by T-Corp, and with that have been given equipment to harness their singularity. You have been given a pocket watch that as a bonus action will let you gain Borrowed Time. While under the effects of borrowed time, you gain 1 Time `Charge::Charge`, advantage on dexterity saving throws, and allows you to use your bonus action to teleport up to half of your movement speed for its duration of 18 seconds (3 rounds). You may use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Additionally, when under the effects of Borrowed Time, you may spend 1 Time Charge to inflict `Amplitude Conversion::Amplitude Conversion` into `Tremor - Chain::Tremor - Chain` after successfully landing a melee attack.

Additionally, after landing a melee attack against a target, you inflict 2 `Tremor::Tremor`. While in Borrowed Time state, you inflict 3 Tremor for every landed melee attack.

Talents.name: Golden Time - Extracting
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you may speed up your regeneration by using your stored time. As a free action upon hitting between 10%-20% of your maximum hit points you may recover xd4+x hit points where x is equal to your level.

Talents.name: Time Moratorium
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you may take time from others and give it to yourself or allies. As an action, you may make a weapon attack against a target creature. On hit the creature is inflicted with `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst`. Upon failing the `Tremor::Tremor` Burst save, the creature becomes stunned and under the effects of Time Moratorium. After a creature is stunned in this way, you gain one charge of Time. While stunned in this way, targets do not take any damage but rather increase Time Moratorium’s stacks by damage dealt. Upon the creature’s stun wearing off, or when they are inflicted by time moratorium while already inflicted with it, the creature will take damage equal to (damage stored x 1.1) rounded up as force damage. You may use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. Any additional uses after will require the use of a time charge. All Time charges will reset after a long rest.

Talents.name: Physics Distortion Field
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your use of time has improved Immensely. As an action and for 2 time charge, you may cast the Slow spell. Gain time charges for every creature who failed the save. All creatures who failed the save are inflicted with 8 `Tremor::Tremor` and on success they are inflicted with 4. Alternatively you may use 2 Time Charges to cast the Haste spell on yourself. While hasted in this way, inflict +2 tremor per hit.

Talents.name: Rewind
Talents.desc: At 13th level, upon failing a saving throw, you may spend one Time charge to reroll the save, taking the new result. You may not use this feature multiple times on the same save.

Talents.name: Time Ripping
Talents.desc: At 17th level you’ve perfected your craft as a collections agent and have been able to implement it in your combat capabilities effortlessly. Upon entering Borrowed Time state, you gain 2 Time Charges instead of 1. Borrowed Time now lasts 1 minute. While under the effects of Borrowed Time, you may as a bonus action use either Time Moratorium or Physics Distortion Field without spending Time Charges. Using these features in this way causes you to leave Borrowed Time state.

Talents.name: Nagel und Hammer
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you have become part of the ranks of N-Corp’s Nagel und Hammer division. With this comes the teachings of right and wrong, good and bad, and you will not be questioned. You can tell at a glance if a creature is a construct or bears any prosthetic. This includes but is not limited to robotic arms. Additionally, when attacking a creature that matches the previous description, they have disadvantage on any wisdom based saves you may impose and take an additional dice of damage when using a piercing or bludgeoning damage.

Talents.name: Drive the Nail
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, you are equipped with large nails that you were trained to stab into your targets and hit with a bludgeoning weapon. You have a number of nails equal to your proficiency bonus and may make more during a short or long rest (half your total rounded down on short rest, all on long rest). These nails are melee weapons that deal 1d4 piercing damage and have the light and finesse property. So long as you have a free hand you can choose any attacks to make with a nail. On hit deal weapon damage and you may choose to embed the nail. While doing this the nail sticks out of the target. At the start of a creatures turn that is inflicted with any Nails, they gain +1 `Bleed::Bleed` for each Nail they have embedded in them. When landing any subsequent attacks against the target with a bludgeoning weapon, you drive the nail further into the target dealing additional 1d4 piercing damage per hit and inflicting +2 bleed. The target may take an action to remove the nail, making a Strength check contesting your Fixer DC. On success the nail is removed while on failure it remains. A creature may only have one nail embedded in them at a time.

Talents.name: Zealot
Talents.desc: At 6th level your mind has been molded and warped… you are a fanatical machine while your drive holds strong. When hit by an attack you may as a reaction gain the fanatic status until the end of your next turn. While fanatic you deal an extra dice of damage on all attacks. You may use this feature a number of times equal to half your proficiency bonus rounded down. Fanatic cannot stack.

Talents.name: Whistles
Talents.desc: At 10th level you’ve taught yourself a little tune that seems to have caught on, becoming recognizable and striking fear into those deserving of your judgment. As a bonus action only upon entering combat, you may cause all creatures of your choice who can hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for the next minute. Affected creatures may remake the save at the end of each of its turns.

Talents.name: Twisted Crusader
Talents.desc: At 13th level you’ve become accustomed to life as an N-Corp associate, and you have quickly climbed the ranks. Your nails now deal 1d6 damage and inflict +3 `Bleed::Bleed` instead of +1 at the start of an inflicted creature's turn. You may now apply two nails into a single target (Example: two nails would deal an additional 2d6 piercing damage per hit with a bludgeoning weapon). Additionally, while fanatic your crit range increases by one. Finally, you are immune to the frightened condition.

Talents.name: The One Who Grips
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you’ve risen to the highest ranks of your unjust crusade. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws and may use your whistles feature twice per combat (once in the beginning, a second time at any other part in the fight). On top of this additional usage all allies who can hear you gain fanatic until the end of their next turn. Additionally, when you apply fanatic to yourself, you may also apply it to one other ally of your choosing. When doing this the ally gains immunity to the frightened condition.

Talents.name: Warp Technology
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you are trained to use the electrically charged weaponry of W Corp. When landing an attack on a target, you gain 2 `Charge::Charge` Count however, charge disappears over time by increments of 1 each round. You can hold up to 20 charges at a time. Additionally, while you have charge your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 lightning damage. This damage dice increases to 1d8 at 6th level, 1d10 at 10th level, and finally 1d12 at 13th level. Your Charge capacity increases by 5 on 3rd, 6th, 10th, 13th and 17th level. When consuming Charge Count for an attack, you do not gain Charge Count for the current attack.

Talents.name: Overcharge
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, your weapons charge allows you to power your weapon’s secondary function, ripping through space to destroy your targets. While at 10 or more `Charge::Charge` Count as an action, you may make a weapon attack. On hit, the target takes weapon damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On failure, they gain 3 `paralysis::Paralysis` stacks and take 5d4 lightning damage. On success, the target takes half lightning damage and does not gain paralysis stacks. This damage dice increases to 5d8 at 6th level.

Talents.name: WARP Weapon Tactics
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, your memories of briefings and manual readings given to you during your rookie days begin to clear up from the decades of mind-numbing Cleanup Missions. You can learn one of the following skills and one more at 6th Level

Charged Leap
Your WARP equipment can now send static shocks that stun targets. As an attack for 3 `Charge::Charge` Count, you leap towards a creature within (your movement speed) of you and make a melee weapon attack. When leaping in this way, you cannot be targeted by opportunity attacks. If hit, you may spend 4 Charge Count for your weapon to release a large amount of static charge through the body of the target, inflicting 2 `Bind::Bind`. You may spend an additional 2 Charge Count to gain 1 `Haste::Haste`. If you hit the attack, gain 2 Charge Count.

Cleanup Support
As an action you may ready a guarding stance in which you brace for any type of impact, in which a glowing sphere WARP Energy surrounds you like a barrier. At 5+ Charge Count, spend said charge gain 1 Charge Barrier for every 5 Charge Count (Max 25 Charge Spent, for 5 Barrier).
*Charge Barrier
Gain (Charge Barrier) * 3 Temporary Hitpoints at the start of your turn for the next minute. If the creature gaining Charge Barrier is a W Corp employee, all Charge Barrier effects activate at (Charge Barrier) * 5 Temporary Hitpoints. Charge Barrier does not work against psychic or status effect damage. It is resistant to Lightning Damage.

Energy Re-Cycle
W Corp has taught you how to make the most of your energy and how to store it to its maximum efficiency...at the cost of your own health. Your Charge count cap increases by 5. You may choose to get 5 Charge Count, but gain 1 Bind until the end of your next turn as a bonus action. You may continue to do this with both the Bind and Charge count rising by 1 with each bonus action taken. If you were to get reduced to 0 Speed by Bind you gain an additional `Paralysis::Paralysis` equal to the amount of times youve used this ability

Subspace Ripple
You have recollected that your weapon can create small tears in space by channelling a large quantity of energy through your weapons, learning some useful tricks to boot. As a bonus action, you may choose a point in which you are able to walk to and place a WARP Rift there with one of the following properties.
*+ Pull or Push
You may spend 5 Charge Count to choose a target within a 30ft Range of the portal. The target must make a Fixer DC Save. On a fail the target is pulled towards the rift, taking 2d6 Force Damage and falling prone (3d6 if the target hits a solid surface). On a success the target takes half the damage and doesnt fall prone
*+ Passageway
You may spend 5 Charge Count to make travel through it relatively safe. If you enter you must roll a 1d20. On a 10 or higher you pass through safely. Being able to move freely  but must exit out during this round. You may exit at any point in time during the round at an unoccupied space. If you exit out next to a creature, you may make an attack of opportunity on it with advantage.

On a 9 or lower you must make Con Save with a DC = to your Fixer Save DC.

On a failure you suffer Warp Sickness. A creature suffering from Warp Sickness takes 4d6 Force damage, gains one level of Exhaustion, and is forcibly ejected from the passage to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the WARP Rift.

On a success you take half the damage, fall prone instead of getting a level of exhaustion, and are still forcibly ejected from the WARP Rift

Talents.name: Re-deployment Clairvoyance
Talents.desc:
At 6th Level, more of your suppressed memories slip through the cracks in the iron wall that is your mind...however, the secret is something no human mind can suppress...not after they've seen it. You can remember one of the following skills.

Energy Current
You can recall the days you swung your weapon with wild abandon...was it for the passengers' sake, to end their eternal suffering, or was it out of your own pure boredom, growing tired and numb to the actions done thousands of times...
Your energy can be consistently carried through multiple attacks. Before making the attack action on your turn, you may spend 10 `Charge::Charge` Count to enhance your weapon with energy strong enough to pierce armour, and your body with the temporary stamina and strength to swing your weapon. You may make up to 4 Attacks this turn with your Weapon For every attack you land this turn, decrease the target's AC by 2 until the end of your next turn, however for every attack you miss you will gain 1 `Fragile::Fragile`. At 11th level you inflict 1 Fragile on each hit.

Rift Rending Strikes
You recall the dreadful days in which you had to do exhausting cleanups on various different trains. How long has it been since you were given a reprieve from your backbreaking labor? Measurements are meaningless...after all, the trains take 10 seconds...right? At less than 15 Charge Count, consume 10 Charge Count to increase the dice tier of one of the follow-up attacks by 1 tier, however, if you have 15 or more Charge Count you may spend 15 Charge Count instead to increase one of the follow up attacks damage dice by 2 tiers.  If 15 Charge Count has been consumed, inflict an additional 3 `Bleed::Bleed`. You may make  3 weapon attacks against a creature you can see within 30ft of you. You dash towards it, aiming for vital points on the body, all the while charging up small, but deadly tears in space. Inflict 3 Bleed for every 5 Charge Count consumed. If the ability consumed 15 Charge Count upon use, inflict 2 Spatial Laceration. At 11th level inflict 4 Spatial Laceration.
*Spatial Laceration
At the end of the creature's turn, the wounds of the creature flare up for a final time, causing an influx of blood to rush out. The creature gains 2 * (Spatial Laceration) Bleed.

Mass Matrix Field
Your countless times protecting the new hires during the train excursions has paid off as your brain fog clears up the details further...but were you saving them out of your own free will, or out of corporate necessity...no matter. Death is but an irrelevant time lag on those accursed trains. As an action, you may slam your weapon down onto the ground and bottleneck it, allowing for the charged energy to transfer into the ground, and by proxy, your allies. You may choose to reduce the action cost to a Bonus Action for this; you will gain 1 Fragile each time you perform this bonus action. While at 10+ Charge count, consume all Charge Count to apply (Consume Charge Count/2) Charge Barrier to 3 Allies of your choice. Said allies also gain 2 `Protection::Protection`. At 11th level your allies gain 4 Protection .

Talents.name: Protocol Override
Talents.desc:
At 10th level more fragmented memories surface from the deep trenches of your poisoned mind. A recollection of memories hits you like one of the freight carts you used to work at. You recall the single split decisions you had to take, along with the risks of the Protocol Override. You put people and suicidals at risk and you will not let it happen again...funny how you have to differentiate them. You may choose one of the following abilities

Rip Space
You transfer a tremendous amount of `Charge::Charge` into your weapon, funnelling it all through the weapon, causing you to be able to create full fractures in the fabric of space. As an action, if you have 30+ Charge count you may spend all available Charge Count to make 5 attack rolls. Adding 2d6 magical lightning damage to the first 4 attacks. The last attack roll deals additional magical lightning damage equal to 1d6 for every 2 Charge Count spent. Using this ability within a minute of using it previously will give you 1 Paralyze and 1 `Bind::Bind` at the start of your next turn.

Rip Dimension
You're ready for devastating blows by overclocking your weapon, allowing for massive damage output along with a buff to your allies. Before you attack, you may apply Load to yourself and all allies equal to the Charge Count you currently have. As an action, spending 30+ Charge count, you may expend all available Charge Count to make 4 attack rolls. Adding a 2d6 bonus lightning damage to each one, along with inflicting 3 `Rupture::Rupture` per attack. On the third attack it inflicts 5 Rupture, and on the fourth attack it inflicts 1 Paralyze. Using this ability within a minute of using it previously will give you 1 Paralyze and 1 Bind at the start of your next turn.

Load
Gain a +1 to damage rolls for every 10 Load. When making an attack that uses Charge, gain a +1 to attack and damage rolls for every 10 Load, and an `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` for every 15 Load, up to a maximum of 4 Offense Level Up.  You may expend all Load at the end of an attack to deal extra magical lightning damage equal to half of your Load count. At the end of your turn, all Load on self expires.

Talents.name: Incomplete CCA Adornment
Talents.desc:
At 13th Level, your memory finally catches up to you as finally snap out of the trance like state you are in...with a gift. You are given a Semi-Functioning Congestive Cleaning Armour suit in a compact form, built to fit anywhere on your person. It could be a small briefcase, a tiny figure of a long lived machine, etc. As an action you may adorn the CCA and gain the following buffs.

* +5 to AC
* Every turn you can choose to either gain Offense Level or `Defense Level up::Defense Level Up` equal to the `Charge::Charge` Potency you have. (Max 3)
* +3 on attack and damage rolls

At the start of every turn, you may convert Charge Count to Potency without an action cost.

You may stay in the CCA up to you (Con Mob + PB) / 2 rounded up Before you start to suffer from over usage of it, causing you to take 1 `Paralysis::Paralysis` and `Bind::Bind`, exponentially rising by 1 each turn you don't take the armour off. At 3 Paralysis and Bind you begin to get `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down` and `Fragile::Fragile` at the same rate.

Talents.name: Dimension Shredder
Talents.desc:
At 17th level, choose one of these three features to be your 17th level ability.

**Dimension Shredder - Overloaded Riptide**

Do not avert your eyes even for a moment, lest you be ensnared in an eternal wandering. It's not there… not behind any of these doors… My path remains in shadows…

As an action, if you have 40+ `Charge::Charge` Count and 3+ Charge Potency, you may consume all available Charge Count and Charge Potency, making 4 attacks, adding another attack for every Charge Potency consumed, to a maximum of 8 attacks.

You may teleport a distance equal to thrice your movement speed between each of these attacks.
You gain a bonus to these attack rolls and damage rolls equal to the Charge Count consumed divided by 10.
Each of these attacks inflict 5 `Rupture::Rupture`. Each attack after the first 4 inflicts 1 `Bind::Bind` and 1 Paralyze.
If you have the `Mastered Sin Affinity::Mastered Sin Affinity` feat, you may use 2 Sin Charges to give yourself advantage on all attacks from this ability.
The final attack automatically critically hits, and forces every creature in a 60ft radius of the targeted creature to make a constitution saving throw, taking 1d6 magical lightning damage for every 2 Charge Count consumed by this attack on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

After using this ability, gain 5 Paralyze, 10 Bind, 3 `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down`, 5 `Fragile::Fragile` and 20 `Sinking::Sinking`, along with being unable to gain charge on your next turn.

You cannot use this ability again before finishing a long rest.

**Dimension Shredder - Space-Time Sanguinism**

Long gone are the days of respite, of rejuvenating rest. You must keep pushing forward, for your destiny has been laid in track by the corporate overlords that hold your strings like a puppet and toy with them at their whims...and a sinking realization then dawns on you...they can cut these strings off and break you apart and splay the gore of your visceral form across the ripped fabrics of space...and then you awake in a cold sweat, back onto that hellish train.

As an action, if you have 40+ Charge Count and 3+ Charge Potency, you may consume all available Charge Count and Charge Potency and activating the following.
You may strike in front of you, creating a large W Corp Rift where you struck.
You may enter said rift, afterwards getting transported to the Ethereal Plane. You are completely invisible and invincible to any outside source that isnt in the same plane as you.
While in the Ethereal Plane you may move up to triple your movement speed.
You may exit out of the Ethereal Plane on the same turn or next turn.
If you stay in there for more than 2 turns. Gain a random Long-Term Madness and be forced out.
As an action while in the Ethereal Plane, you rip open a rift below the target. The target must succeed a dexterity saving throw with the DC being your Fixer DC + 10.
On a fail: The target is dragged into the Ethereal Plane and make 4 attacks with advantage against the creature, dealing an additional 10 Sinking per Attack hit. On the final attack inflict an additional 10 Spatial Laceration and Long Term Madness. Then, both you you leave the Ethereal Plane. This Long Term madness cannot be one that would render the creature unconscious, and would be rerolled if it was that.
On a success: The target dodges out of the way, not getting dragged into the Ethereal Plane, you instead jump out of the rift and follow up an attack action, making an extra attack. Afterwards, you get 10 Charge Count refunded.

You cannot use this ability again before finishing a long rest.

**Dimension Shredder - Crackling Pylon**

It feels like it has been forever. More than forever, multiple eternities. Lifetimes blending together, thoughts growing distant, reality growing father and farther away. Then, your shift is finally over.

As an action, if you have 40+ Charge Count and 3+ Charge Potency, you may consume all available Charge Count and Charge Potency, making a storm of electricity and spatial rifts tear apart your enemies, while energising and shielding your allies.

Every hostile creature in 120ft radius of you make a constitution saving throw, taking 1d6 magical lightning damage for every 2 Charge Count consumed by this attack on a failed save, or half as much on a success. For each Charge Potency, inflict 2 Paralyze and 2 Bind.

Then, yourself and all friendly creatures within a 120ft radius gain 3 `Protection::Protection`, 1 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` and 3 `Haste::Haste`. Friendly creatures in this radius also gain Charge Barrier equal to 5+(Charge Potency Consumed), with you gaining an 5 extra Charge Barrier and 5 Haste. Buffs from this E.G.O last until your Charge Barrier from it depletes.

You cannot use this ability again before finishing a long rest.

Talents.name: Crimson Strike
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, gain a +1 to attack and damage rolls against targets for every 2 unique negative effects the target has. If the target has `Rupture::Rupture`, gain an additional +1 to the bonus. If you have 5+ `Poise::Poise`, gain an additional +1 to the bonus.

Additionally, You gain proficiency in unarmed strikes dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage + strength or dexterity. This damage dice increases to 1d8 at 5th level, 1d10 at 10th level, and finally 1d12 at 15th level. Additionally, as a bonus action you may make an additional unarmed strike. On Hit with an unarmed strike, inflict (Proficiency Bonus) Rupture or gain 1 Poise.

Talents.name: Crimson Phoenix
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, upon landing a critical hit onto an enemy, before lowering the `Rupture::Rupture` Stack, gain `Poise::Poise` equal to the Rupture on the target (Max 5 Poise). After reducing the Rupture stack, inflict (Poise Gained) Rupture. If a creature with rupture dies, then gain Poise equal to the rupture on the dead creature (Max 5) and gain 1 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` at the start of your next turn, gain 1 Additional Offense Level Up if you were the one to kill the creature.

Talents.name: Jin Gang Bolus
Talents.desc: At 6th level, Upon losing a `Clash::Clashing`, Twice per Turn, Before taking damage, gain 1 `Defense Level Up::Defense Level Up`. You will also gain an additional reaction for the purposes of clashing.

Talents.name: Adept Evasion
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, when taking the Dodge Action and successfully dodging an attack, you will gain 2 `Poise::Poise`, 1 Ready [待], and you may make a free attack action against the attacker. You can only make the free attack action once per turn.

* Ready [待]:

**Max Stack: 5**

Creatures gain -(X * 3) `Clash::Clashing` Power in a Clash against this creature. Creatures gain -(X * 2) to their attack rolls when attacking this creature when it has used the Dodge Action. This effect goes away when combat is over.

Talents.name: Redirected Counter
Talents.desc: At 13th level, after winning a clash and resolving it, you may make a free ‘Crimson Cleave’ attack action. This attack has the same roll as your unarmed strike, but gains a bonus to the attack roll for every 3 `Rupture::Rupture` on the target (Up to +5). On Hit, it will the same amount of rupture your unarmed strike would inflict, or gain the same amount of poise you would gain, and you will inflict 2 `Defense Level Down::Defense Level Down`. The ‘Crimson Cleave’ attack cannot be clashed with.

Talents.name: Hierarch of Hongyuan
Talents.desc: At 17th level, at the start of your turn, you will apply 2 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` and 1 `Defense Level Up::Defense Level Up` to all allies, including this character. You can spend 2 `Light::Light` to inflict the effects twice.

Talents.name: Blinkstep
Talents.desc: At 1st level, you gain a +5ft bonus to your movement speed, a +4 to your initiative rolls, and if your initiative is faster than a another creature's initiative by 10 or more, you will gain a +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls against that creature. Additionally, when you make an initiative roll, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10. At 8th level, you gain a +6 to your initiative rolls. At 13th level, you gain a +8 to your initiative rolls.

Talents.name: Overspeed
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, as an action, you perform a special dash attack. This counts as a dash for increasing your speed for it. On contact with a creature while dashing, the creature must take a Dexterity saving throw. On failure they take damage equal to your weapons damage dice. This ability cannot affect the same creature multiple times with one dash. You may use this ability once per long rest, or twice once you reach 10th level. You may expend 4 light to regain a use of this feature, no action cost required.

Talents.name: Cursed Blade
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your blade will become cursed. Attacks will melee weapons will inflict a special status called Deathrite. Any creatures that have the Deathrite status will have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws. You will have advantage on creatures who have this status. The affected creature can roll a charisma saving throw as an action against your Fixer DC to get rid of the Deathrite status. Only one creature can have Deathrite at a time. If a creature has passed the saving throw to get rid of Deathrite, then they cannot gain the status again for an entire day.

Talents.name: Weave
Talents.desc: At 6th level, you are able to dodge attacks incredibly effectively. As a reaction to being targeted by an attack, you may roll a dexterity saving throw, dodging the attack if you roll higher than the aggressor's attack roll. If you have evasion, you have advantage on this save.

Talents.name: Rupturing Strike
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your attacks will inflict a special status called `Rupture::Rupture`. Your attacks inflict 4 Rupture into any creature hit. If the enemy that is being hit has the Deathrite status, then they will be hit with 8 Rupture on a hit instead.

Talents.name: Dominator
Talents.desc: At 13th level, When creatures that are slower than you attack you by a difference of 20ft, their critical miss range is increased to 1-3. If you are attacking a creature that you are faster than, your critical range is increased to 19-20. Once per turn, if you land a critical strike, make an extra attack roll with advantage.

Talents.name: Cursewrit Butcherblade
Talents.desc: At 17th level, As an action, you can make 2 special attack rolls on an creature in your melee range. For every 30ft of movement you have more than the creature you make an additional attack. The final attack will hit all creatures within a 15 foot radius of the you, if the attack roll would have hit them, and will inflict double the `rupture::Rupture` stacks. This move may do a maximum of 7 attacks. You may do this an amount of times equal to half of your dexterity modifier per long rest.

Talents.name: Heishou Mutation - Si
Talents.desc:
Starting at 1st level, you start off with the ability to transform your arms into snakes. As an action, you gain an amount of temporary hit points equal to your level + your constitution modifier until you lose all stacks of this effect, and gain Serpent's Arm for 3 rounds, boosting your combat abilities and gaining the benefits of Serpent's Arm. If a creature deals damage to you without depleting your temporary hit points, you may make a single basic weapon attack against the attacker as a reaction. At the third round, it ends at the end of your turn.

**Serpent's Arm**

At the start of each round while you have this effect, you gain 2 `poise::Poise`.

**You gain a bonus to your damage rolls by your proficiency bonus**

**You inflict 3 `rupture::Rupture` on each hit**

Talents.name: Deadly Venom
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, you are capable of inflicting a poisonous effect that stays dormant until the target takes lethal damage, making sure a target is dead from a single critical blow. As an action, or as a bonus action if you used Heishou Mutation - Si this turn, you may make a single attack roll and on a hit, it inflicts 5 Deathrite【Venom】

**Deathrite【Venom】**

Reduces stack by 1 upon getting hit by a CRIT, when the stack is reduced, the target gains a -1 to their attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Additionally, store 10 `Rupture::Rupture` that was on the target in this effect.

Upon reaching 0 stacks, the target takes extra damage equal to the stored rupture on the effect, the target then loses this debuff.

Talents.name: Snake Fang
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your swordsmanship has improved, allowing you to take your time on an attack to hit your target’s where it hurts. You may forgo one of your attacks during your attack action to gain 4 `Poise::Poise`, and on hit with your next attack inflict 5 `Rupture::Rupture`. If Serpent’s Arm is active, inflict an additional 3 Rupture. On crit, inflict double rupture and only halve rupture after the attack lands, rather than completely removing it.

Talents.name: Coiled to Strike
Talents.desc: At 10th level, your eyes have been trained to spot easy targets and how to ensure you land your most important attacks when it matters most. Gain +1 `Poise::Poise` when hitting a creature inflicted with Deathrite【Venom】.For every 2 poise you currently have, gain a +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls. This benefit does not apply for a full attack action but will track between all separate attacks within the attack action. Ex: Attack 1 gains a +2 to attack and damage rolls because you have 4 poise. After the roll the attack lands and is critical due to poise. The second attack of the attack action does not gain the +2 because after the poise caused the critical hit previously, it was instantly depleted, meaning the second attack is rolled as normal.

Talents.name: Improved Serpent's Arm
Talents.desc: At 13th level, after continued use and mutation, your serpent’s arm feels more natural and you’ve been able to take advantage of it to it’s full potential. Your reach increases by 5ft while Serpent's Arm is active.

Talents.name: Supreme Serpent's Art
Talents.desc:
At 17th level, you have mastered your mutation and developed a final attack that puts your whole body into an attack. Choose one of the following, this decision cannot be changed later.

* Serpent’s Mortal Flurry: Target all hostile creatures in a 30ft radius and making 9 attacks. After targeting, all creatures or parts are targeted at random either by rolling dice to decide or by other means. When a creature is targeted, make a melee attack roll against them, on hit deal weapon damage and reduce Deathrite【Venom】by 1, and then randomly select the next target. A creature can only be hit up to 3 times by this ability, retargeting if they would be hit again, and you may pick a creature to guarantee to be targeted for the first 3 attacks. Coiled to Strike will count for every attack made in Serpent’s Mortal Flurry. You may use this ability once per combat.
* Serpenshear Puncturing Arm: As an attack, make an attack roll against a target within 20ft. On hit deal weapon damage+2d12+`Poise::Poise`. On hit this attack depletes Deathrite【Venom】fully. If this attack is a critical, triple the damage instead of doubling it and extend Serpent’s Arms duration back to 3 turns. After using Serpenshear Puncturing Arm, it must be recharged on a D6 roll of 5 or 6, rolled at the start of your turn.

Talents.name: Heishou Mutation - You
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, you can spend a bonus action to coat your weapon in flaming blood and gain 3 Bloodflame [血炎] on yourself. You can use this feature amount of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. If you have no uses of Bloodflame remaining at the start of combat, you may expend 3 light to regain a use. While Bloodflame [血炎] is active, you gain the following benefits.

Additionally, you gain +1 to attack and damage rolls per 5 `burn::Burn` on enemies with a maximum up to half of your proficiency bonus.

**Bloodflame [血炎]**

Additional damage added by your damage modifier becomes fire damage and inflicts equal burn count.

Gain +1 to your attack and damage rolls upon killing an enemy. After killing an additional enemy, gain 1 `Offense level up::Offense Level Up`.

Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls per 5 burn on enemies with a maximum up to half of your proficiency bonus.

Lose 1 stack of Bloodflame [血炎] at the end of your turn. You may only have a maximum of 3 Bloodflame [血炎] at a time.

Talents.name: Let's get battle-drunk
Talents.desc: At 3rd level, the effects of the You branch bolus begin to take full hold of your body causing you to become stronger the more hurt you are. When at half hit points or lower gain one `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` and `Haste::Haste` and inflict 1 extra `Burn::Burn`. The buffs increase to 1 Offense level up, 2 `Defense level up::Defense Level Up`, 2 Haste and 3 extra Burn inflicted upon being at quarter of your hit points or lower.

Talents.name: Rooster's Deathstrike
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your strikes become devastating enough to rip targets apart. After landing an attack on a target inflicted with the `burn::Burn` status, inflict `Rupture::Rupture` equal to half of the burn potency you would apply (min 1).

Talents.name: Flame Rooster's Death Defiance [炎鳥不死戦]
Talents.desc: At 10th level, when you start your turn while at or under 25% of your maximum hit points, halve all damage taken until you start your turn above 25% of your maximum hit points. You may choose to not be healed by effects that would heal you past this threshold, if those effects originate from you. When reduced to 0 hit points, you may instead set your hit points to 25% of your maximum hit points. You may only do this once per long rest.

Talents.name: Fuel my Rampage
Talents.desc: At 13th level, upon hitting a target who is inflicted with `Burn::Burn` and `Rupture::Rupture` while either having "Bloodflame [血炎]" on yourself or be at half of your hit points or lower, you can attack additional time once per turn.

Talents.name: Bloodflame Massacre [血炎亂舞]
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you can unleash your rampageous spirit and start to exterminate the vermin who oppose you. As an action, make 5 weapon attacks against different targets within an area equal to your movement speed. If there are less than 5 targets in range, you may attack the same target more than once, but no more than 3 times, and you must attack every creature within your range that you can at least once. If you have "Bloodflame [血炎]" on yourself, you may make an additional weapon attack. If you are at half of your hit points or lower, make an additional weapon attack. If you are at quarter of your hit points or lower, make two additional weapon attacks instead of one and deal extra damage to every target equal to your missing hit points divided by 5. You may use Bloodflame Massacre [血炎亂舞] once per long rest.

Talents.name: Mastered Bolus
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you have tripled maximum uses of Heishou Mutation - You, and when you regain a use, regain 3 uses instead.

Talents.name: Obsidian Stormrider [黑風馬脚]
Talents.desc:
At 1st level, the bolus has begun to course through your body granting you superhuman fortitude and speed. As a bonus action, you gain 3 stacks of Strider [Wu]. While under the effects of Strider [Wu] you gain the following benefits.

* Gain 2 `Haste::Haste` at the end of the turn
* Gain 2 x (Strider [Wu]) on self `Aggro::Aggro` at the end of the turn.
* When attacking a creature, inflict tremor equal to Strider [Wu] on self.
* Lose 1 stack of Strider [Wu] at the end of turn.
* Strider [Wu] may only stack up to 3.

You may use Obsidian Stormrider [黑風馬脚] a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. If you have no uses of Obsidian Stormrider remaining at the start of combat, you may expend 3 light to regain a use.

Talents.name: Linebreaker
Talents.desc:
At 3rd level, your strong body has become more than capable of breaking through enemy lines and fighting on the frontlines. You gain the ability to gain the Linebreaker status. The Linebreaker status can be gained in the following ways.

* Winning a clash while having Strider [Wu] stacks on self
* Successfully burst a `Tremor::Tremor` stack on a target.
* Taking the dash action on your turn

**While Linebreaker is active, you gain the following benefits**

* At the beginning of your turn, gain a number of temporary hitpoints equal to Linebreaker stack x 2. Temporary hitpoints are removed at the beginning of your next turn.
* Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls. This does not change when you get more linebreaker stacks.
* You may only have a maximum number of Linebreaker stats on self equal to your proficiency bonus.
* Linebreaker stacks are fully removed after not making an attack roll or taking damage for one round.
* You may expend one linebreaker stack to inflict `tremor burst::Tremor Burst` upon rolling damage after a successful attack roll or after winning a clash.

Talents.name: The Steed's Houndlike Loyalty
Talents.desc: At 6th level, your loyalty shows above all even when your body fails to keep up. When engaging in a clash, you may inflict `tremor::Tremor` on the target equal to your damage modifier. Additionally you gain the ability to assist an ally in a clash so long as they are within your movement range. Upon an ally clashing against a creature you may use your reaction to move up to your movement speed towards the clash. You must end up within 5ft of the creature you intend to assist in this clash. Once within range, you may add your damage modifier to the result of the assisted creatures damage roll for the clash. If the creature you assisted loses the clash, you become the target of any features or effects from the creature who you lost the clash to. You may use this feature a number of times equal to half your constitution modifier rounded up (minimum of 1). Additionally, if you have the protector feat, your range for its usage increases to your movement speed, and you move to the creature that you are protecting when using it.

Talents.name: Preparation Afore The Charge
Talents.desc:
At 10th level, your larger frame may be brought forth, changing your body into that akin to a centaur with your horse half boasts long black fur. You may change to this form as at the beginning of your turn as a free action before you use an action, bonus action, or movement. While your body is changed in this way you gain the following benefits.

* +15ft movement
* Size category increases by one
* Gain 1 `offense level up::Offense Level Up`
* Inflict +3 `tremor::Tremor` per hit.

This transformation lasts until the end of your next turn or if used outside of combat may be maintained for upwards of 1 hour without needing to spend an additional usage. You may use this transformation a number of times equal to half of your proficiency bonus rounded up, and you may regain a use at the start of combat for 3 `Light::Light`, if you have no charges at the start of combat.

Talents.name: Wu Branch Adept
Talents.desc: At 13th level, you’ve become more resilient to the aftereffects of combat. While below half of your max hp, you take half damage from burn, bleed, rupture, tremor, and sinking based effects. If these effects would reduce you to below half of your maximum hit points when you are above them, halve them as well. Additionally, when falling to 0 hit points once per long rest, you may stay on 1 hit point, before dropping back down to 0 at the end of your turn.

Talents.name: Cavalry's Vanguard Charge
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you have fully embraced your role of the frontline fighter as the ground quakes with your arrival. While you have line breaker stacks and you are transformed via Preparation Afore The Charge, you may make a special melee attack as part of your movement. Moving on your turn, you may choose to take your movement in a straight line. All creatures within your melee reach at the end of this movement must make a Strength saving throw or take your weapon damage and fall prone. On successful save, creatures take half damage and are not knocked prone. Additionally, you may `burst tremor::Tremor Burst` on a creature that fails the save. You may use this feature once per 5 rounds. In order to use this feature, you must move at least 10ft towards a creature.

Talents.name: Mastered Bolus
Talents.desc: At 17th level, you have twice the amount of uses of Obsidian Stormrider and Preparation Afore The Charge now lasts for a minute rather than until the end of your next turn. Additionally, your light cost for regaining charges of these abilities is reduced to 2, and you regain 2 charges of Obsidian Stormrider when you use light to regain it.
